title_en: Strong Jet Stream Leads To Transatlantic Flights Reporting Overspeed Incidents
title_zh: 强劲急流导致跨大西洋航班报告超速事件
summary: Strong jet streams triggered transatlantic overspeed alerts, highlighting how powerful winds can affect aircraft speed, flight times and safety.
summary_zh: 强烈的急流触发了跨大西洋超速警报，凸显了强风对飞机速度、飞行时间和安全的影响。
body_en: Experienced ICAO English Language Proficiency Instructor for pilots and ATCOs and conference interpreter who is passionate about facilitating effective communication within aviation-related businesses. Possess a deep understanding of the aviation industry, including aviation regulations, terminology, and industry-specific communication protocols. Has been working at numerous airshows across Europe since 2014. Being an ultralight pilot in her free time, she also promotes safety and efficiency in aviation operations.

Transatlantic flights encountered unusually strong jet stream conditions on November 3 and 4, 2026, with several aircraft reportedly experiencing overspeed alerts while crossing the Atlantic Ocean. Among them was British Airways Flight BA252, operated by a Boeing 777-200, which briefly exceeded its reported operational speed limit by approximately 7–10 knots. The incident occurred during an overnight flight from Nassau (NAS), Bahamas, to London Heathrow Airport (LHR), as powerful upper-level winds affected aircraft operating along the North Atlantic corridor.

The incidents highlight how changing atmospheric conditions can affect long-haul flight operations, particularly in autumn and winter when the jet stream often strengthens. Although powerful tailwinds can significantly increase an aircraft's ground speed and shorten eastbound journeys, sudden wind changes can also create additional challenges for flight crews. These events also highlight clear-air turbulence , another phenomenon often associated with jet stream activity.
British Airways Boeing 777 Reports Overspeed During Atlantic Crossing

According to AIRLIVE's report , the incident involved BA252, a British Airways Boeing 777-200 registered as G-VIID. The aircraft departed NAS on November 3 and was crossing the Atlantic towards LHR on November 4 when it encountered particularly strong upper-level winds. While cruising at 38,000 feet, the aircraft reportedly reached approximately 282 knots, around 7–10 knots above its applicable operational limit.

The flight crew responded by changing altitude, initially climbing to 39,000 feet before subsequently reaching 41,000 feet. These adjustments were intended to find more favorable atmospheric conditions and stabilize the aircraft's speed. Despite the reported overspeed, the flight continued to its destination without further reported complications, landing at Heathrow at 11:13 GMT on November 4 after seven hours and 57 minutes.

Several other transatlantic aircraft experienced similar overspeed alerts during the same period. However, available open-source information did not provide individual flight numbers or details of the circumstances. No injuries or structural damage were reported in connection with BA252.
How Jet Streams Can Push Eastbound Flights To Exceptional Speeds

The November overspeed incidents occurred during a period of particularly active atmospheric conditions over the North Atlantic. According to the UK Met Office , the jet stream is a narrow band of powerful winds approximately five to seven miles (26,400–36,960 feet) above the Earth's surface, generally traveling from west to east. It forms near the boundary between colder polar air and warmer tropical air, influencing weather systems and wind conditions across the Atlantic.

Aircraft traveling eastbound can benefit considerably from these winds . As Aerospace Global News explains, jet streams can reach speeds exceeding 250 mph (402 km/h), providing strong tailwinds for aircraft traveling in the same direction. This can reduce flight times and fuel consumption, while westbound services often encounter stronger headwinds and consequently longer journeys.

The phenomenon has produced some remarkable ground-speed figures in recent years. In February 2024, two Boeing 787 Dreamliners operated by Virgin Atlantic and United Airlines recorded ground speeds exceeding 800 mph (1,287 km/h) while crossing the Atlantic. According to Business Insider , the aircraft reached about 802 mph and 838 mph, respectively, thanks to exceptionally strong winds. However, these figures did not mean the aircraft exceeded its aerodynamic operating speeds.

Tailwinds increase ground speed rather than automatically increasing airspeed. An aircraft's aerodynamic speed is measured relative to the surrounding air, whereas ground speed accounts for the wind's effect, as NASA explains . However, sudden changes in wind direction or velocity, known as wind shear, can temporarily affect indicated airspeed. Consequently, the precise relationship between the jet stream and the reported British Airways overspeed requires caution: the available report does not establish the exact aerodynamic mechanism behind the alert.
What Is The Jet Stream And Does It Present Safety Risks?

Although jet streams shorten eastbound journeys, they can also create challenging conditions for flight crews. Their strength and position change throughout the year, with the temperature difference between polar and tropical regions playing an important role. The Met Office explains that autumn and winter generally bring stronger westerly winds as the polar regions cool, making the jet stream more active and influencing weather across the North Atlantic. Its analysis of seasonal jet stream changes explains why these atmospheric patterns become particularly noticeable during colder months.

One associated phenomenon is clear-air turbulence (CAT) , which can occur without visible clouds or thunderstorms. It is frequently linked to jet streams and differences in wind speed and direction at cruising altitude. According to Aerospace Global News , conventional onboard weather radar cannot directly detect clear-air turbulence, meaning pilots must rely on forecasts, reports from other aircraft, and air traffic control information to anticipate potentially dangerous conditions.

Another study cited by Air Traveler Club indicates that severe clear-air turbulence over a representative point in the North Atlantic increased by 55% between 1979 and 2020. Aircraft are designed to withstand considerable turbulence, but sudden movements can injure passengers and cabin crew who are not wearing seatbelts.

The Met Office's analysis of the recent Storm Austen also demonstrates the jet stream's influence on Atlantic weather systems. Its interaction with a powerful jet streak helped the storm deepen rapidly, illustrating how changing upper-level winds can affect conditions across the region.

While the British Airways incident ended without reported injuries or aircraft damage, the November 3–4 events demonstrate the importance of monitoring atmospheric conditions during transatlantic operations. Strong tailwinds can offer considerable operational advantages, but changing wind patterns and associated turbulence remain important considerations for airlines and flight crews.
body_zh: 经验丰富的国际民航组织飞行员和空中交通管制员英语语言能力讲师以及会议口译员，热衷于促进航空相关业务中的有效沟通。对航空业有深入的了解，包括航空法规、术语和行业特定的通信协议。自 2014 年以来，她一直在欧洲各地的众多航展上工作。作为一名超轻型飞行员，她在业余时间还致力于提高航空运营的安全性和效率。
2026 年 11 月 3 日至 4 日，跨大西洋航班遇到了异常强烈的急流状况，据报道有几架飞机在飞越大西洋时收到超速警报。其中包括由波音 777-200 运营的英国航空 BA252 航班，该航班短暂超出其报告的运行速度限制约 7 至 10 节。该事件发生在从巴哈马拿骚 (NAS) 飞往伦敦希思罗机场 (LHR) 的夜间飞行期间，当时强风影响了沿北大西洋走廊运行的飞机。
这些事件凸显了大气条件的变化如何影响长途飞行运营，特别是在急流经常增强的秋季和冬季。尽管强大的顺风可以显着提高飞机的地面速度并缩短东行行程，但突然的风向变化也会给机组人员带来额外的挑战。这些事件还凸显了晴空湍流，这是另一种通常与急流活动相关的现象。
英国航空波音 777 报告在穿越大西洋期间超速
据AIRLIVE报道，此次事件涉及BA252，一架注册为G-VIID的英国航空公司波音777-200。这架飞机于 11 月 3 日从 NAS 起飞，并于 11 月 4 日穿越大西洋飞往 LHR，当时遇到了特别强的高空风。据报道，飞机在 38,000 英尺高度巡航时，速度达到了约 282 节，比适用的运行极限高出约 7 至 10 节。
机组人员通过改变高度做出反应，最初爬升至 39,000 英尺，随后升至 41,000 英尺。这些调整的目的是为了找到更有利的大气条件并稳定飞机的速度。尽管有报道称超速，该航班仍继续飞往目的地，没有出现进一步的并发症，历时 7 小时 57 分钟后于 11 月 4 日格林尼治标准时间 11 点 13 分降落在希思罗机场。
其他几架跨大西洋飞机在同一时期也经历了类似的超速警报。然而，现有的开源信息并未提供个别航班号或情况细节。没有与 BA252 有关的伤害或结构损坏的报告。
急流如何将东行航班推向超快速度
11 月份的超速事件发生在北大西洋大气条件特别活跃的时期。据英国气象局称，急流是距地球表面约 5 至 7 英里（26,400-36,960 英尺）的狭窄强风带，通常从西向东传播。它形成于较冷的极地空气和较温暖的热带空气之间的边界附近，影响整个大西洋的天气系统和风况。
向东飞行的飞机可以从这些风中受益匪浅。正如《航空航天全球新闻》所解释的那样，急流的速度可以超过 250 英里/小时（402 公里/小时），为同向飞行的飞机提供强大的顺风。这可以减少飞行时间和燃油消耗，而西行服务经常会遇到更强的逆风，从而导致更长的旅程。
近年来，这种现象产生了一些引人注目的地面速度数据。 2024 年 2 月，维珍航空和联合航空运营的两架波音 787 梦想飞机在穿越大西洋时记录到的地面速度超过 800 英里/小时（1,287 公里/小时）。据 Business Insider 报道，由于异常强风，飞机的时速分别达到约 802 英里和 838 英里。然而，这些数字并不意味着飞机超出了其空气动力运行速度。
顺风会增加地面速度，而不是自动增加空速。正如美国宇航局解释的那样，飞机的空气动力速度是相对于周围空气测量的，而地面速度则考虑了风的影响。然而，风向或风速的突然变化（称为风切变）可能会暂时影响指示空速。因此，急流与报告的英国航空公司超速之间的精确关系需要谨慎：现有报告并未建立警报背后的确切空气动力学机制。
什么是急流？它会带来安全风险吗？
尽管急流缩短了向东飞行的旅程，但它们也给机组人员带来了挑战性的条件。它们的强度和位置全年都在变化，其中极地和热带地区的温差起着重要作用。英国气象局解释说，随着极地地区变冷，秋冬季节通常会带来更强的西风，使急流更加活跃，影响北大西洋的天气。它对季节性急流变化的分析解释了为什么这些大气模式在寒冷的月份变得特别明显。
一种相关现象是晴空湍流 (CAT)，这种现象可能在没有可见云或雷暴的情况下发生。它通常与急流以及巡航高度的风速和风向差异有关。据《航空航天全球新闻》报道，传统的机载气象雷达无法直接检测晴空湍流，这意味着飞行员必须依靠预报、其他飞机的报告和空中交通管制信息来预测潜在的危险情况。
航空旅行者俱乐部引用的另一项研究表明，1979 年至 2020 年间，北大西洋一个代表性地点上空的严重晴空湍流增加了 55%。飞机的设计能够承受相当大的湍流，但突然的运动可能会伤害未系安全带的乘客和机组人员。

英国气象局对最近的奥斯汀风暴的分析也证明了急流对大西洋天气系统的影响。它与强大急流的相互作用帮助风暴迅速加深，这说明了高层风的变化如何影响整个地区的状况。
虽然英国航空事件最终没有报告人员伤亡或飞机损坏，但 11 月 3 日至 4 日的事件证明了在跨大西洋运营期间监测大气状况的重要性。强劲的顺风可以提供相当大的运营优势，但不断变化的风型和相关的湍流仍然是航空公司和机组人员的重要考虑因素。

title_en: Why Airports Remove Rubber Deposits From Runways To Keep Jets Braking Safely
title_zh: 为什么机场要清除跑道上的橡胶沉积物以确保喷气式飞机安全制动
summary: The move is key to keeping operations safe.
summary_zh: 此举是确保运营安全的关键。
body_en: Journalist - Steven has a varied background in communications, and it was this passion for writing combined with his in-depth knowledge of the aviation industry that led him to Simple Flying. A keen linguist, he also has experience in translation and interpreting. Based in Palma, Spain

Every time a passenger jet touches down, its tires leave behind a small amount of rubber on the runway . Although this is a normal part of aircraft operations, thousands of landings can eventually create a significant buildup, especially where aircraft first make contact with the runway. Over time, these deposits can reduce the surface friction that aircraft tires need to slow down safely.

For airports, removing this accumulated rubber is an important part of routine runway maintenance, helping preserve braking performance, reduce the risk of hydroplaning, and maintain safe operating conditions in different weather. The process involves specialized equipment, careful monitoring, and carefully scheduled maintenance windows, with airports needing to balance effective cleaning against the possibility of damaging the pavement itself.
Why Aircraft Tires Leave Rubber Deposits Behind

When an aircraft lands, its tires initially make contact with the runway while rotating at a relatively low speed , then rapidly accelerate to match the aircraft's forward movement. This sudden change creates considerable friction between the tires and the pavement, causing small quantities of rubber to wear away and transfer onto the runway surface. The deposits are particularly concentrated in the touchdown zone, where aircraft wheels first contact the pavement during landing. This area generally extends approximately 150 to 450 meters beyond the runway threshold, although the precise distribution depends on aircraft performance, landing techniques, and operational conditions.

Although individual landings leave relatively little rubber behind, the cumulative effect becomes significant at busy airports handling hundreds of aircraft movements every day. Heavier aircraft such as the Airbus A380 or Boeing 747 can contribute particularly substantial deposits because their tires experience considerable forces during touchdown, making runways frequently used by widebody jets especially important maintenance priorities. The rubber gradually becomes embedded in the pavement's surface texture, particularly when the heat generated during touchdown helps bond the material to the runway. As additional aircraft land, successive layers accumulate, eventually filling small surface irregularities and runway grooves that would otherwise help provide the friction needed for effective aircraft braking.
How Rubber Buildup Affects Aircraft Braking Performance

Runway pavement is designed to provide sufficient friction between aircraft tires and the ground, allowing pilots to reduce speed after touchdown while maintaining directional control. Its surface texture plays an important role in this process, helping tires maintain contact with the pavement rather than sliding across a smoother, potentially slippery surface.

When rubber deposits accumulate, they gradually cover the microscopic texture of the pavement and can obstruct the grooves cut into some runway surfaces. This reduces the ability of the runway to provide consistent friction, potentially making it harder for aircraft to slow down, particularly when braking conditions are already challenging.

The problem becomes especially important during wet weather, when water collects between aircraft tires and the runway. Properly maintained pavement texture and grooves help channel water away from the contact area, reducing the possibility of hydroplaning, a condition in which tires lose effective contact with the surface and braking performance deteriorates.

Research and airport maintenance observations have highlighted how substantial this deterioration can become in heavily contaminated touchdown zones, where friction levels may be 15% to 30% lower than elsewhere on the runway. Consequently, rubber removal is not simply an appearance-related maintenance task but an important measure for preserving the conditions required for safe aircraft operations.

Airport operators do not generally wait until rubber deposits become visibly excessive before arranging maintenance. Instead, they use specialized friction-measuring equipment to evaluate runway surface conditions, identifying areas where accumulated contamination or pavement deterioration could affect aircraft braking performance. The US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) provides guidance through its Advisory Circular 150/5320-12 series , which addresses the measurement and maintenance of skid-resistant airport pavement surfaces.

The guidance considers factors including aircraft movements, pavement characteristics, and the condition of the runway when determining how frequently friction assessments should take place. Inspection frequency increases with the number of daily jet landings. The guidance describes annual measurements for runway ends receiving fewer than 15 daily jet landings, quarterly assessments for those receiving between 31 and 90, monthly assessments for 91 to 150, and weekly measurements where traffic exceeds 210 daily landings.

Aircraft size is another consideration because widebody jets can contribute more substantial rubber deposits than smaller aircraft . The FAA guidance recommends increasing inspection frequency by one level when widebody aircraft account for more than 20% of landings on a particular runway end. When measurements indicate inadequate friction, airports can arrange rubber removal before considering more extensive pavement rehabilitation.
The Different Methods Used To Remove Runway Rubber

There are several ways airports can remove accumulated rubber, with the appropriate approach depending on the pavement material, the severity of contamination, and the condition of the runway. The FAA identifies high-pressure water, chemical solvents, high-velocity impact using abrasive materials, and mechanical grinding among the available removal techniques. High-pressure waterblasting is one of the most widely used methods because it can remove stubborn deposits without necessarily damaging the underlying pavement. Specialized vehicles direct powerful streams of water onto contaminated areas, breaking away the rubber and exposing the original surface texture and grooves beneath the accumulated material.
body_zh: 记者 - 史蒂文在传播领域拥有不同的背景，正是这种对写作的热情与他对航空业的深入了解相结合，促使他创立了《简单飞行》。作为一位敏锐的语言学家，他还拥有翻译和口译经验。总部位于西班牙帕尔马
每次客机着陆时，其轮胎都会在跑道上留下少量橡胶。尽管这是飞机运行的正常部分，但数千次着陆最终可能会造成严重的堆积，特别是在飞机首次接触跑道的地方。随着时间的推移，这些沉积物会减少飞机轮胎安全减速所需的表面摩擦力。
对于机场来说，清除这些积聚的橡胶是日常跑道维护的重要组成部分，有助于保持制动性能，降低滑水风险，并在不同天气下保持安全运行条件。该过程涉及专用设备、仔细监控和精心安排的维护窗口，机场需要在有效清洁与损坏人行道本身的可能性之间取得平衡。
为什么飞机轮胎会留下橡胶沉积物
当飞机着陆时，其轮胎最初与跑道接触，同时以相对较低的速度旋转，然后迅速加速以配合飞机的向前运动。这种突然的变化在轮胎和路面之间产生相当大的摩擦力，导致少量橡胶磨损并转移到跑道表面上。这些沉积物特别集中在着陆区，飞机轮子在着陆期间首先接触路面。该区域通常超出跑道入口约 150 至 450 米，但精确分布取决于飞机性能、着陆技术和运行条件。

尽管单次着陆留下的橡胶相对较少，但在每天处理数百架飞机起降的繁忙机场中，累积效应变得非常显着。空中客车 A380 或波音 747 等重型飞机可能会产生特别大量的沉积物，因为它们的轮胎在接地过程中会承受相当大的力，这使得宽体喷气式飞机经常使用的跑道特别重要的维护优先事项。橡胶逐渐嵌入路面的表面纹理中，特别是当着陆过程中产生的热量有助于将材料粘合到跑道上时。随着更多飞机着陆，连续的层不断累积，最终填充小的表面不规则处和跑道凹槽，否则有助于提供有效飞机制动所需的摩擦力。
橡胶堆积如何影响飞机制动性能
跑道路面的设计目的是在飞机轮胎和地面之间提供足够的摩擦力，使飞行员能够在着陆后降低速度，同时保持方向控制。其表面纹理在此过程中发挥着重要作用，帮助轮胎保持与路面的接触，而不是在更光滑、可能打滑的表面上滑动。
当橡胶沉积物积累时，它们会逐渐覆盖路面的微观纹理，并可能堵塞某些跑道表面的凹槽。这降低了跑道提供一致摩擦力的能力，可能使飞机更难减速，特别是在制动条件已经很困难的情况下。
在潮湿天气期间，当飞机轮胎和跑道之间积水时，这个问题变得尤其重要。正确维护的路面纹理和凹槽有助于将水从接触区域引走，减少打滑的可能性，在这种情况下，轮胎与表面失去有效​​接触，制动性能恶化。
研究和机场维护观察强调，在严重污染的着陆区，这种恶化会变得多么严重，那里的摩擦水平可能比跑道上其他地方低 15% 到 30%。因此，橡胶去除不仅仅是一项与外观相关的维护任务，而是维护飞机安全运行所需条件的重要措施。
机场运营商通常不会等到橡胶沉积物明显过多才安排维护。相反，他们使用专门的摩擦测量设备来评估跑道表面状况，识别累积污染或路面恶化可能影响飞机制动性能的区域。美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 通过其咨询通告 150/5320-12 系列提供指导，涉及防滑机场路面的测量和维护。
该指南在确定进行摩擦力评估的频率时考虑了飞机起降、路面特征和跑道状况等因素。检查频率随着每日飞机起降次数的增加而增加。该指南描述了对每日飞机起落次数少于 15 次的跑道末端进行年度测量，对 31 至 90 次起降的跑道末端进行季度评估，对 91 至 150 次起降的跑道末端进行每月评估，以及对每日起降次数超过 210 次的跑道末端进行每周测量。
飞机尺寸是另一个考虑因素，因为宽体喷气式飞机比小型飞机可以提供更多的橡胶沉积物。 FAA 指南建议，当宽体飞机在特定跑道末端的着陆次数超过 20% 时，应将检查频率提高一级。当测量结果表明摩擦力不足时，机场可以在考虑更广泛的路面修复之前安排橡胶去除。
去除跑道橡胶的不同方法
机场可以采用多种方法清除积聚的橡胶，具体方法取决于路面材料、污染严重程度和跑道状况。美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 确定了可用的去除技术包括高压水、化学溶剂、使用研磨材料的高速冲击以及机械研磨。高压水喷射是最广泛使用的方法之一，因为它可以去除顽固的沉积物，而不必损坏下面的路面。专用车辆将强大的水流引导到污染区域，破坏橡胶并暴露出累积材料下方的原始表面纹理和凹槽。

title_en: British Airways Boeing 787 Stranded In Pittsburgh For 2 Months Due To Complicated Repairs
title_zh: 英国航空波音787因维修复杂滞留在匹兹堡两个月
summary: A hole punctured into the 787's fuselage by a service vehicle has kept this British Airways 787 grounded for 70+ days in Pittsburgh.
summary_zh: 一架服务车辆在 787 机身上刺穿了一个洞，导致这架英国航空 787 飞机在匹兹堡停飞了 70 多天。
body_en: Jasper Yu-Dawidowicz is a New York City-based aviation journalist with over seven years of journalism experience across different publications. Currently an undergradate student, Jasper is pursuing dual degrees in Professional Flight and Aviation management, completing his flight training as part of Purdue's part 141 R-ATP eligible program.

A British Airways Boeing 787-8 Dreamliner has been stranded at Pittsburgh International Airport (PIT) in Pennsylvania for over two months after reportedly sustaining significant damage during a ground-handling incident. The aircraft, registered as G-ZBJF, arrived at PIT from London Heathrow Airport (LHR) on August 28, 2026, operating as flight BA 171. However, instead of a routine transatlantic arrival, a ground service vehicle collided with the aircraft, damaging its underside and rendering it unable to return to the skies ever since.

More than 70 days later, the 12-year-old Dreamliner remains in Pittsburgh , with reports flagged by Turbine Traveller suggesting that the repair process has proven to be much more complicated than initially anticipated. As reported by several travelers, potential damage to the aircraft’s landing gear system continues to delay the maintenance repair process. Simple Flying has reached out to British Airways for comment on G-ZBJF’s extended stay in the City of Bridges and will update coverage upon receiving a response.
Ground Equipment Collision Leaves British Airways 787 Stranded For 70+ Days

G-ZBJF arrived in Pittsburgh on August 28, 2026, after completing its roughly 3,233-nautical-mile (5,987 km) journey across the Atlantic Ocean. The aircraft had departed Heathrow five minutes early of its 4:40 PM departure time, landing in Pennsylvania at approximately 8:23 PM local time. However, the G-ZBJF never operated its return service to London later that night, with subsequent reports indicating that the 787-8 had sustained severe damage while on the ground. Flight tracking data and visual sightings of the jet confirm that the aircraft is still on the ground in Pittsburgh as of November 8, 2026.

According to discussions among aviation enthusiasts on Reddit , the incident that led to G-ZBJF’s grounding involved a mobile baggage belt loader that reportedly struck the airframe underneath one of its bulk cargo doors. The belt loader, a piece of ground service equipment used by ramp personnel to load and unload luggage from the 787’s cargo hold, was raised up into position but ended up piercing the fuselage, leaving a hole in the cargo bay’s exterior. Although the exact details beyond this have not been confirmed, the continued presence of the aircraft in Pittsburgh suggests a major structural issue requiring a significant engineering solution.

The repair process could be particularly challenging given the Boeing 787’s construction. Unlike older aircraft that primarily use conventional aluminum structures, about 50% of the Dreamliner’s primary structure is made from composite materials . This includes significant portions of its fuselage and wings, requiring specialized inspection and repair procedures in the event of substantial structural damage.

Depending on the severity, British Airways maintenance engineers may have to construct a specialized patch to apply to the exterior of the Dreamliner. This would allow the plane to be ferried to a larger maintenance base capable and equipped to handle the 787 where more extensive work can be completed. In order to be transported to one of these locations, however, the aircraft would have to be approved by the FAA to complete a one-off ferry flight via the use of a FAA special flight permit (SFP) .
Landing Gear Damage Could Complicate The Repair Process

Since the initial damage to G-ZBJF, several people have reported the aircraft is potentially also facing damage to the landing gear system. According to a commenter on a November 8th discussion thread , a British Airways engineer who had worked on the Dreamliner said repair work was well underway on the aircraft, but technicians had encountered additional complications involving damage to the jet’s landing gear system. While this account has not been independently verified, it could help explain why the Dreamliner has remained grounded for so long.

A separate report suggests that British Airways could be preparing to reposition the airplane to Cincinnati Northern Kentucky International Airport after completing temporary repairs in Pittsburgh. The reported plan would potentially allow the 787 to be moved to a larger facility operated by FEAM Aero, a maintenance services provider, where the aircraft could be more permanently repaired before returning to the United Kingdom. Ferrying the jet to Boeing’s 787 facilities in Seattle could also be another option, as Boeing would be well-equipped to handle any repairs to the aircraft’s composite structure if needed.

For British Airways, getting G-ZBJF back into the skies is a high priority. Currently, the UK flag carrier operates a total of 12 Boeing 787-8 aircraft according to planespotters.net . G-ZBJF is approximately 12 years old, having first flown in April 2014 before being delivered to British Airways the following month. While it is not uncommon for airplanes to be parked for routine maintenance checks, the prolonged grounding of G-ZBJF is costing the airline not only potentially millions in repair fees, but hundreds of thousands in lost revenue potential and roughly $175,000 in gate parking charges, according to the rates published by the Allegheny County Airport Authority which runs Pittsburgh International. While British Airways likely isn’t paying this full amount given insurance coverage and the fault of the ground service operator, it goes without a doubt the airline would rather have its aircraft flying passengers than sitting on the ground in Pittsburgh.

Interestingly, the Pittsburgh incident is not the first time this year G-ZBJF has spent an extended period away from flying passengers. Before its latest grounding, the Dreamliner already spent nearly eight months at Cardiff Airport (CWL) in Wales, where British Airways operates a major maintenance facility, being placed into long-term storage before D-checks were completed on the Dreamliner. Aircraft tracking records show that G-ZBJF arrived in Cardiff on December 19, 2025, and remained there until August 6, 2026. After nearly eight months in Cardiff, the aircraft returned to commercial operations on August 7, 2026, meaning it had only been back in service for approximately three weeks before being stranded in Pittsburgh.
G-ZBJF ferried to Cardiff for long-term storage and maintenance checks.
G-ZBJF completes D-check at Cardiff maintenance base.
G-ZBJF returns to operational service after being ferried from Cardiff to London.
G-ZBJF operates BA171 from LHR to PIT and is subsequently grounded in Pittsburgh after a ground service vehicle collided with the aircraft's underside.
body_zh: Jasper Yu-Dawidowicz 是一位驻纽约市的航空记者，在不同出版物上拥有超过七年的新闻经验。 Jasper 目前是一名本科生，正在攻读专业飞行和航空管理双学位，并作为普渡大学第 141 部分 R-ATP 合格计划的一部分完成飞行培训。
据报道，英国航空一架波音 787-8 梦想客机在地勤事故中遭受严重损坏，已在宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡国际机场 (PIT) 滞留两个多月。这架注册号为 G-ZBJF 的飞机于 2026 年 8 月 28 日从伦敦希思罗机场 (LHR) 抵达 PIT，航班号为 BA 171。然而，这架飞机并没有按照例行方式跨大西洋抵达，而是与飞机相撞，导致飞机底部受损，从此无法返回天空。
70 多天后，这架已有 12 年历史的梦想飞机仍然留在匹兹堡，Turbine Traveler 指出的报道表明，事实证明维修过程比最初预期的要复杂得多。据几位旅客报告，飞机起落架系统的潜在损坏继续推迟维护修理过程。 Simple Flying 已联系英国航空，请其就 G-ZBJF 在桥梁之城的延长停留发表评论，并将在收到回复后更新报道内容。
地面设备碰撞导致英国航空 787 滞留 70 多天

G-ZBJF 在完成横跨大西洋约 3,233 海里（5,987 公里）的旅程后于 2026 年 8 月 28 日抵达匹兹堡。这架飞机比下午 4:40 起飞时间提前五分钟从希思罗机场起飞，于当地时间晚上 8:23 左右降落在宾夕法尼亚州。然而，当晚晚些时候，G-ZBJF 从未运营返回伦敦的航班，随后的报告表明 787-8 在地面上遭受了严重损坏。该飞机的飞行跟踪数据和目视目击证实，截至 2026 年 11 月 8 日，该飞机仍在匹兹堡地面上。
根据 Reddit 上航空爱好者的讨论，导致 G-ZBJF 停飞的事件涉及一台移动行李带装载机，据报道该事件撞到了其散货舱门下方的机身。皮带装载机是坡道人员用来从 787 货舱装卸行李的地面服务设备，它被提升到位，但最终刺穿了机身，在货舱外部留下了一个洞。尽管除此之外的具体细节尚未得到证实，但这架飞机在匹兹堡的持续存在表明存在重大结构问题，需要重大的工程解决方案。
鉴于波音 787 的构造，维修过程可能特别具有挑战性。与主要使用传统铝结构的旧飞机不同，梦想客机约 50% 的主要结构由复合材料制成。这包括其机身和机翼的重要部分，在发生重大结构损坏时需要专门的检查和维修程序。
根据严重程度，英国航空维护工程师可能必须制作专门的补丁以应用于梦想客机的外部。这将使飞机能够被运送到一个更大的维护基地，该基地有能力和装备来处理 787，在那里可以完成更广泛的工作。然而，为了运输到这些地点之一，飞机必须获得美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 的批准，才能使用联邦航空局 (FAA) 特殊飞行许可证 (SFP) 完成一次性渡轮飞行。
起落架损坏可能会使维修过程复杂化
自 G-ZBJF 最初受损以来，一些人报告称该飞机的起落架系统也可能受到损坏。据 11 月 8 日讨论帖中的一位评论者称，一位曾在梦想客机上工作过的英国航空公司工程师表示，飞机的维修工作正在顺利进行，但技术人员遇到了其他复杂情况，包括飞机起落架系统损坏。虽然这一说法尚未得到独立证实，但它可能有助于解释为什么梦想客机长期处于停飞状态。
另一份报告表明，英国航空公司可能正准备在匹兹堡完成临时维修后将飞机重新安置到辛辛那提北肯塔基国际机场。据报道，该计划可能会将 787 飞机转移到维护服务提供商 FEAM Aero 运营的更大设施中，在那里飞机可以在返回英国之前进行更永久的维修。将这架飞机运送到波音公司位于西雅图的 787 工厂也可能是另一种选择，因为波音公司将装备精良，可以在需要时处理飞机复合结构的任何维修。

对于英国航空公司来说，让 G-ZBJF 重返天空是当务之急。据planespotters.net称，目前，这家英国旗舰航空公司总共运营着12架波音787-8飞机。 G-ZBJF 已有约 12 年历史，于 2014 年 4 月首飞，并于次月交付给英国航空公司。虽然飞机停飞进行例行维护检查的情况并不少见，但根据匹兹堡国际机场运营商阿勒格尼县机场管理局公布的费率，G-ZBJF 的长期停飞不仅给航空公司带来了数百万美元的潜在维修费，而且还可能造成数十万美元的收入损失，以及大约 175,000 美元的登机口停车费。尽管考虑到保险范围和地面服务运营商的过错，英国航空可能不会全额支付这笔费用，但毫无疑问，该航空公司宁愿让飞机载客，也不愿坐在匹兹堡的地面上。

有趣的是，匹兹堡事件并不是G-ZBJF今年第一次长时间远离飞行乘客。在最近一次停飞之前，梦想客机已经在威尔士卡迪夫机场 (CWL) 停留了近八个月，英国航空公司在那里运营着一个主要的维护设施，在梦想客机完成 D 检查之前被置于长期存放状态。飞机跟踪记录显示，G-ZBJF于2025年12月19日抵达卡迪夫，并在那里一直停留到2026年8月6日。在卡迪夫停留近八个月后，这架飞机于2026年8月7日恢复商业运营，这意味着它在滞留在匹兹堡之前只重新投入使用约三周。
G-ZBJF 被运送到卡迪夫进行长期存储和维护检查。
G-ZBJF在卡迪夫维修基地完成D检。
G-ZBJF 从卡迪夫运送到伦敦后恢复运营服务。
G-ZBJF 运营 BA171 从 LHR 飞往 PIT，随后在地面服务车辆与飞机底部相撞后在匹兹堡停飞。

title_en: The Aircraft Replacing The Chinook
title_zh: 取代支奴干的飞机
summary: What will be the next Army heavy lifter?
summary_zh: 下一个陆军举重运动员将是什么？
body_en: Luke Diaz is a freelance military writer with experience with active duty experience in the US Navy as well as defense and industrial engineering. He is a former Naval Flight Officer who performed tactical air control on the carrier-based E-2 Hawkeye.

As it stands, there is technically no official replacement for the Boeing CH-47 yet under US Army development. Significant progress on the Sikorsky UH-60 Black Hawk’s successor has taken place in recent years, however. That is the Bell V-280 Valor, a tiltrotor under development that has key differences from its older cousin, Bell-Boeing’s V-22 Osprey.

The lack of a direct successor for the heavy-duty whirlybird has led to some speculation that the Army may consolidate its fleet, with the backbone model being the Valor (officially designated MV-25). Concerns about the CH-47F’s survivability in contested airspace and vast domains like the Pacific lend credence to the possibility of a total phase-out.

The Chinook’s unrivaled heavy-lift capability and outstanding track record make it a favorite with the special forces communities of the US Department of Defense. The Army’s Chinook fleet numbers more than 470 aircraft and is expected to serve as the primary heavy-lift rotorcraft for many more years to come.

Since debuting in 1961, the Chinook has never been toppled as the apex of tandem-rotor helicopters. The soviets experimented with tandem-rotor designs, but favored different configurations for heavy lift. Even the US Navy and Marines’ CH-46 has been retired for a decade. The Chinook is still being modernized, as the Block II variant offers a gross weight increase of 54,000 pounds, upgraded fuel systems, and rotor blades.

Honeywell has developed the new T55-714C, with 20% more power and 8% better fuel efficiency than previous powerplants. Vertical Mag quoted General John Murray in 2021, saying that no replacement had been planned yet, and the Chinook remains a critical asset for Army Special Forces, among other missions
“The Future Attack Reconnaissance Aircraft and the Future Long Range Assault Aircraft are the two plans, programs we have working right now. There is nothing working for a replacement for the CH-47.”

The first CH-47F Block II Chinooks reached the Army in 2024, and the first of a scheduled 465 helicopters was delivered in July of that year, according to World of Aviation. Some compare the CH-47 to the equally enduring B-52, for being so good at what it does that there simply is no replacement. Perhaps it will soldier on into the distant future, but let's explore the latest challenger and if it has what it takes to fill the Chinooks’ place on the flightline.

The Army’s Future Vertical Lift program sought to develop the Future Long Range Assault Attack, or FLRAA. The winning platform was Bell Textron’s V-280 Valor tiltrotor. The new aircraft will initially supplement the UH-60 Black Hawk fleet but will likely replace the aging Sikorsky completely over time.

Although the V-280 is cut from the same cloth as the Bell-Boeing Osprey, engineers have implemented key differences from the start. Aside from a smaller overall footprint, the V-280 uses a V-tail configuration rather than the V-22’s twin vertical fin tail. While the V-22’s nacelles, which house both the engine and gearbox, fully rotate, only the V-280’s props and gearbox move while the engines remain fixed during transition between flight modes.

The V-280 also features a different clutch to the V-22’s problematic design, as it operates more like a conventional helicopter. The Osprey’s transmission has been linked to fatal hard-clutch engagements on more than one occasion and requires somewhere in the ballpark of 45 days to replace, according to Military.com .

The Bell V-280 Valor is a next-generation tiltrotor aircraft developed specifically by Bell-Textron for the US Army's FLRAA program. The V-280's defining feature is its ability to transition between helicopter-like vertical flight and airplane-like forward flight by tilting its rotors and drive shafts. It offers significant improvements in speed, range, and maneuverability over the UH-60.

This allows vertical takeoff and landing like a helicopter while providing speed and range comparable to a fixed-wing aircraft. Flying as fast as 300 knots, the Valor is almost twice as fast as the Chinook, which tops out at 170 knots. The Valor also surpasses the Chinook in range by a long shot.

Under combat load, the CH-47 can only go about 400 NM, while the V-280 can fly 800 NM on a single fill-up without any aerial refueling . The Valor can perform fast-rope sling-loading like the UH-60 or CH-47, but armament has yet to be publicly revealed. A key area where it falls short of the CH-47 is, inevitably, raw payload.

The V-280, or MV-25 as it recently became designated, has under half the sling-load capacity at 10,000 lbs compared to the Chinook’s 26,000 lbs. The Valor can’t compete with the Chinook in weight or volume capacity, which is the crux of the issue when it comes to replacing the venerable CH-47.

Like its Bell-Boeing V-22 Osprey predecessor , Valor’s tiltrotor design is a radical departure from conventional rotorcraft. The MV-25 is equipped with two Rolls-Royce AE 1107F engines, which are of the same powerplant family as used in the C-130 Hercules, Global Hawk drone, and V-22 Osprey.

The V-280 gearbox design has been refined from the V-22's design into a simpler, lighter, and more easily maintainable design. This new system eliminates the need for a mid-wing gearbox, which cuts the total number of gearboxes from five to four, versus the Osprey.

The design allows for a straight wing design that reduces complexity and eliminates a number of failure points. The V-280's stationary engines result in weight savings, thanks to fewer parts, and the lower empty weight also allows for better performance and fuel efficiency.
body_zh: 卢克·迪亚兹 (Luke Diaz) 是一位自由军事作家，拥有在美国海军以及国防和工业工程领域服役的现役经验。他是一名前海军飞行军官，曾在舰载 E-2 鹰眼上执行战术空中控制。
就目前情况而言，美国陆军在技术上尚未开发出波音 CH-47 的官方替代品。然而，西科斯基 UH-60 黑鹰的后继机近年来取得了重大进展。这就是贝尔 V-280 Valor，一种正在开发的倾转旋翼机，与其老表亲贝尔-波音的 V-22 鱼鹰有重大区别。
由于缺乏重型旋翼飞机的直接继任者，有人猜测陆军可能会整合其机队，其中骨干型号是“勇敢”（官方指定为 MV-25）。对 CH-47F 在有争议空域和太平洋等广阔领域的生存能力的担忧增加了完全淘汰的可能性。
选择一架飞机，看看现在有多少架飞机在空中
支努干直升机无与伦比的重型运输能力和出色的记录使其成为美国国防部特种部队的最爱。陆军的“支奴干”机队拥有 470 多架飞机，预计将在未来许多年中充当主要的重型旋翼机。
自 1961 年首次亮相以来，奇努克直升机作为串联旋翼直升机的巅峰之作从未被推翻。苏联尝试了串联转子设计，但更倾向于采用不同的重载配置。就连美国海军和海军陆战队的CH-46也已经退役十年了。支奴干仍在进行现代化改造，Block II 变型的总重量增加了 54,000 磅，并升级了燃油系统和旋翼叶片。
霍尼韦尔开发了新型 T55-714C，与以前的发动机相比，功率增加了 20%，燃油效率提高了 8%。 Vertical Mag 在 2021 年援引约翰·默里 (John Murray) 将军的话说，目前尚未计划更换，“支奴干”仍然是陆军特种部队以及其他任务的重要资产
“未来攻击侦察机和未来远程攻击机是我们目前正在进行的两个计划和项目。目前还没有任何替代品可以替代 CH-47。”
据《航空世界》报道，第一架 CH-47F Block II 支奴干直升机于 2024 年交付陆军，计划交付的 465 架直升机中的第一架于当年 7 月交付。有人将 CH-47 与同样经久不衰的 B-52 进行比较，因为它的性能非常出色，无可替代。也许它会在遥远的未来继续存在，但让我们来探讨一下最新的挑战者，看看它是否有能力填补支奴干在航线上的位置。
陆军的未来垂直升力计划旨在开发未来远程突击攻击（FLRAA）。获胜平台是贝尔德事隆的 V-280 Valor 倾转旋翼机。新飞机最初将补充 UH-60 黑鹰机队，但随着时间的推移可能会完全取代老化的西科斯基飞机。
尽管 V-280 与贝尔波音鱼鹰的设计相同，但工程师从一开始就实现了关键的差异。除了较小的整体占地面积外，V-280 采用 V 型尾翼配置，而不是 V-22 的双垂直尾翼。 V-22 的发动机舱（容纳发动机和变速箱）可完全旋转，但只有 V-280 的螺旋桨和变速箱移动，而发动机在飞行模式之间的转换期间保持固定。
V-280 还采用了与 V-22 有问题的设计不同的离合器，因为它的操作方式更像传统直升机。据 Military.com 报道，“鱼鹰”的变速箱曾不止一次与致命的硬离合事故有关，大约需要 45 天进行更换。
贝尔 V-280 Valor 是贝尔-德事隆专为美国陆军 FLRAA 计划开发的下一代倾转旋翼机。 V-280 的显着特点是能够通过倾斜旋翼和驱动轴在直升机般的垂直飞行和飞机般的向前飞行之间进行转换。与 UH-60 相比，它在速度、航程和机动性方面都有显着改进。
这允许像直升机一样垂直起飞和着陆，同时提供与固定翼飞机相当的速度和航程。 Valor 的飞行速度高达 300 节，几乎是 Chinook 的两倍，后者的最高时速为 170 节。勇气号的射程也远远超过了支奴干号。
在战斗负载下，CH-47 只能飞行约 400 海里，而 V-280 在没有任何空中加油的情况下一次加油即可飞行 800 海里。 Valor 可以像 UH-60 或 CH-47 一样进行快速绳索装载，但武器装备尚未公开。它不可避免地与 CH-47 相比的一个关键领域是原始有效载荷。
V-280（或最近命名的 MV-25）的吊索负载能力为 10,000 磅，而 Chinook 的吊索负载能力为 26,000 磅，只有一半以下。 Valor 在重量和体积方面都无法与 Chinook 竞争，这是更换古老的 CH-47 时问题的关键。
与贝尔-波音 V-22 鱼鹰前身一样，Valor 的倾转旋翼机设计与传统旋翼机截然不同。 MV-25 配备两台劳斯莱斯 AE 1107F 发动机，与 C-130 Hercules、全球鹰无人机和 V-22 Osprey 所使用的动力装置系列相同。
V-280 变速箱设计在 V-22 的基础上进行了改进，变得更简单、更轻且更易于维护。与“鱼鹰”相比，这种新系统消除了对中翼变速箱的需求，从而将变速箱总数从五个减少到四个。
该设计允许采用直翼设计，从而降低复杂性并消除许多故障点。 V-280 的固定式发动机由于零件较少而减轻了重量，而且较低的空重还可以实现更好的性能和燃油效率。

title_en: Analysis: Airbus A350 Passengers Often Don't Feel As Tired After Flying Long-Haul Compared To A Boeing 777
title_zh: 分析：与波音 777 相比，空客 A350 乘客在长途飞行后通常不会感到疲劳
summary: Over many hours of flying, a lower cabin altitude can help passengers feel more rested upon arrival.
summary_zh: 在长时间的飞行中，较低的机舱高度可以帮助乘客在抵达时感到更加休息。
body_en: Jack comes to Simple Flying with a lifelong interest in all things aviation. He holds a degree in Aerospace Engineering from Georgia Tech, and is a certified private and remote pilot. Beyond these experiences, Jack previously worked for a corporate flight department where he gained first-hand experience in the world of business aviation. Currently, Jack works in the professional services industry and continues to build his flight hours outside of work.

Passengers stepping off a 12-hour flight may feel noticeably better after traveling on an Airbus A350 than after making a similar journey aboard an older Boeing 777 . The difference is not simply a matter of seat comfort or airline service. The A350 was designed around a newer cabin environment, incorporating lower pressurization altitude, improved humidity retention, and noise-control measures intended to reduce the physical strain of spending many hours in the air.

These features have a credible scientific basis for mattering, though the evidence requires qualification. No major controlled study has directly compared passenger fatigue after equivalent A350 and 777 flights. Aircraft configuration, airline operating practices, seating density, sleep opportunity, and individual health all influence how travelers feel. Nevertheless, the A350 offers several potential advantages over many earlier 777s, particularly on very long sectors. Those benefits can make the journey less taxing, even though they cannot eliminate jet lag.
A Lower Cabin Altitude Can Reduce The Strain Of Long Flights

One of the A350's most consequential comfort features is its ability to maintain a lower cabin altitude. Although the aircraft may cruise above 35,000 feet, its pressurization system keeps the cabin environment at a much lower equivalent altitude. Airbus specifies a cabin altitude of 6,000 feet (1,828 meters) for the A350, a level made possible in part by its carbon-fiber-reinforced plastic fuselage. Older Boeing 777 variants generally operate within the conventional commercial-aircraft limit of 8,000 feet (2,438 meters) at maximum operating altitude. This is a regulatory ceiling, not a guarantee that every 777 flight remains at precisely 8,000 feet. Actual cabin altitude changes during a flight and varies with operating conditions. Even so, the potential difference between a 6,000-foot A350 cabin and an 8,000-foot cabin is physiologically meaningful.

A 2007 study published in the New England Journal of Medicine examined 502 volunteers during simulated flights in a controlled hypobaric chamber. Researchers exposed participants to cabin pressures equivalent to altitudes ranging from 650 feet to 8,000 feet. At the highest simulated altitude, average oxygen saturation fell by as much as 4.4 percentage points compared with the lowest condition. Participants also reported more discomfort, including fatigue and muscular discomfort, at 7,000 to 8,000 feet. Those differences emerged after three to nine hours of exposure.

The researchers did not find that the lower oxygen levels caused acute mountain sickness or measurable impairment in sensory and psychomotor testing. Their conclusion was more specific: maintaining a cabin altitude of 6,000 feet or lower could reduce passenger discomfort on long flights. This supports the A350's approach, but it does not prove that every traveler will arrive less tired or that the aircraft prevents fatigue. Pressurization performance varies by generation and operating conditions. Nevertheless, the A350's lower target gives it a tangible advantage in an area where scientific research has established a relationship between cabin altitude and passenger discomfort.
Composite Construction Helps The A350 Retain More Cabin Moisture

Cabin humidity is another factor that can influence how comfortable passengers feel after a long flight. The air supplied to aircraft cabins at cruising altitude is extremely dry. Relative humidity on many long-haul flights commonly falls between 10% and 20%, well below levels people experience indoors on the ground. Low humidity does not normally cause clinically significant dehydration in healthy passengers. It can, however, dry the eyes, nose, throat, and skin, making a long journey feel less comfortable. Increasing cabin humidity improved nasal comfort while reducing ocular, nasal, and skin symptoms.

The A350's composite fuselage helps address an engineering constraint behind cabin humidity. Traditional aluminum structures are more vulnerable to corrosion when exposed to sustained moisture, so aircraft manufacturers have historically limited humidity to reduce the risk of condensation and structural deterioration. Composite materials are less susceptible to that form of corrosion, giving designers greater flexibility to manage moisture levels.

Airbus says the A350 combines its carbon-fiber structure with improved humidity levels during cruise, contributing to lower passenger fatigue. Independent aviation-health research also notes that newer composite aircraft, including the A350 and Boeing 787, can retain more moisture than older designs. Cruise humidity around 15% has been reported in some cases. This does not mean every A350 cabin remains at 15% to 20% throughout a flight. Humidity varies with passenger numbers, ventilation rates, and operating conditions, and it is not routinely monitored in commercial cabins. Passengers may notice fewer dry-eye symptoms or less irritation after many hours, particularly when improved moisture retention accompanies lower cabin altitude. Humidity alone is unlikely to determine whether someone arrives exhausted, but it can remove one source of discomfort that becomes more noticeable as flight time increases.
A Quieter Cabin Can Make Rest More Achievable

Noise is less straightforward to compare because measurements depend on where they are taken, which engines power the aircraft, the phase of flight, and the seating area. Airbus describes the A350 as the quietest aircraft in its category and says its noise-optimized airframe and engine nacelles can make it up to nine decibels quieter than competing aircraft. The Rolls-Royce Trent XWB engines, aerodynamic design, and cabin insulation contribute to its acoustic environment.
body_zh: Jack 带着对航空一切事物的终生兴趣加入了 Simple Flying。他拥有佐治亚理工学院的航空航天工程学位，并且是一名经过认证的私人和远程飞行员。除了这些经验之外，杰克还曾在公司飞行部门工作过，在那里他获得了公务航空领域的第一手经验。目前，杰克在专业服务行业工作，并在工作之外继续增加飞行时间。
乘坐空客 A350 完成 12 小时飞行后的乘客可能会比乘坐旧款波音 777 进行类似旅程后感觉明显更好。差异不仅仅是座椅舒适度或航空公司服务的问题。 A350 是围绕更新的机舱环境而设计的，采用了较低的增压高度、改进的湿度保持和噪音控制措施，旨在减少长时间飞行带来的身体压力。
尽管证据需要限定，但这些特征具有重要的可信科学基础。目前还没有大型对照研究直接比较 A350 和 777 同等航班后乘客的疲劳程度。飞机配置、航空公司运营实践、座位密度、睡眠机会和个人健康都会影响旅客的感受。尽管如此，与许多早期的 777 相比，A350 仍具有一些潜在优势，特别是在很长的航段上。这些好处可以减轻旅途的负担，尽管它们不能消除时差。
较低的机舱高度可以减轻长途飞行的压力

A350 最重要的舒适特性之一是它能够保持较低的客舱高度。尽管飞机可能巡航高度超过 35,000 英尺，但其增压系统使机舱环境保持在低得多的等效高度。空中客车公司规定 A350 的机舱高度为 6,000 英尺（1,828 米），这一水平在一定程度上得益于其碳纤维增强塑料机身。较旧的波音 777 型号通常在最大运行高度 8,000 英尺（2,438 米）的传统商用飞机限制内运行。这是监管上限，并不能保证每架 777 航班都保持在 8,000 英尺的高度。实际客舱高度在飞行过程中会发生变化，并随运行条件的变化而变化。即便如此，6,000 英尺的 A350 客舱和 8,000 英尺的客舱之间的潜在差异在生理上是有意义的。
2007 年发表在《新英格兰医学杂志》上的一项研究对 502 名志愿者在受控低压室中进行模拟飞行进行了检查。研究人员让参与者承受相当于 650 英尺到 8,000 英尺海拔高度的机舱压力。在最高模拟海拔下，平均氧饱和度较最低条件下降多达4.4个百分点。参与者还报告称，在 7,000 至 8,000 英尺的高度感到更多不适，包括疲劳和肌肉不适。这些差异在暴露三到九个小时后就出现了。
研究人员没有发现较低的氧气水平会导致急性高山病或感觉和精神运动测试中明显的损害。他们的结论更为具体：将机舱高度保持在 6,000 英尺或更低可以减少乘客在长途飞行中的不适。这支持了 A350 的做法，但并不能证明每位旅客到达时不会那么疲劳，或者飞机可以防止疲劳。加压性能因发电和运行条件而异。尽管如此，A350 较低的目标使其在科学研究已确定机舱高度与乘客不适之间存在关系的领域具有明显的优势。
复合材料结构帮助 A350 保留更多的机舱湿度
机舱湿度是影响长途飞行后乘客舒适度的另一个因素。巡航高度的飞机机舱供应的空气极其干燥。许多长途航班上的相对湿度通常在 10% 到 20% 之间，远低于人们在室内地面所经历的水平。低湿度通常不会导致健康乘客出现临床上明显的脱水。然而，它会使眼睛、鼻子、喉咙和皮肤干燥，使长途旅行感觉不太舒服。增加机舱湿度可改善鼻部舒适度，同时减少眼部、鼻部和皮肤症状。
A350 的复合材料机身有助于解决机舱湿度背后的工程限制。传统的铝结构在持续潮湿的情况下更容易腐蚀，因此飞机制造商历来限制湿度，以降低凝结和结构恶化的风险。复合材料不易受到这种形式的腐蚀，使设计人员能够更灵活地管理湿度水平。

空中客车公司表示，A350 将其碳纤维结构与巡航期间改善的湿度水平相结合，有助于减轻乘客的疲劳。独立航空健康研究还指出，新型复合材料飞机，包括 A350 和波音 787，可以比旧设计保留更多的水分。据报道，在某些情况下邮轮湿度约为 15%。这并不意味着每个 A350 客舱在整个飞行过程中都保持在 15% 到 20% 的状态。湿度随着乘客数量、通风率和运行条件的变化而变化，并且在商务客舱中并不进行常规监测。几个小时后，乘客可能会注意到干眼症状或刺激症状减少，特别是当客舱海拔较低且保湿效果改善时。仅凭湿度不太可能确定某人是否疲惫不堪，但它可以消除随着飞行时间增加而变得更加明显的不适来源。
更安静的客舱可以让休息更容易
噪声不太容易比较，因为测量值取决于测量地点、飞机的发动机、飞行阶段和座位区域。空中客车公司将 A350 描述为同类飞机中最安静的飞机，并表示其经过噪音优化的机身和发动机短舱可使其比竞争对手的飞机安静多达 9 分贝。劳斯莱斯遄达 XWB 发动机、空气动力学设计和机舱隔音有助于改善其声学环境。

title_en: Why Singapore Airlines Uses Boeing 787-10s On Short Regional Routes
title_zh: 为什么新加坡航空在短途支线航线上使用波音 787-10 飞机
summary: Singapore Airlines configures its 787-10s for high density and short routes.
summary_zh: 新加坡航空将 787-10 飞机配置为高密度和短途航线。
body_en: Louis is a military historian and the staff writer for History of War magazine, a leading military history monthly. He also has an interest in private and commercial aviation.

Boeing built the 787-10 Dreamliner as the largest Dreamliner variant with the shortest range. That makes it well suited to high-frequency, high-demand medium-length routes. Yet, with a maximum range of 7,500 nautical miles (13,890 km), it is still capable of traditional long-haul missions. Singapore Airlines takes its 787-10s in a different direction, using them to fly bizarrely short routes, typically the domain of narrowbody jets.

Singapore Airlines uses its Dreamliner in an unexpected way for several reasons. The 787-10 is a modern jet that replaced the carrier's older widebody aircraft. It has a high-density configuration ideal for ferrying a large number of passengers. It is also fuel-efficient and versatile, making it cost-effective on a range of routes. The answer is also in Singapore Airlines' current fleet, which lacks capacity for short-haul routes with other jets.
Singapore Airlines Operates Some Seriously Short Routes Using Its 787-10s

Cirium data reveals that Singapore Airlines will fly the 787-10 on 26 routes throughout November. This is for a total of 1,129 operations and over 380,000 seats, with each jet having 337 seats available onboard. The majority of these 26 routes are regional, coming in at less than a third of the 787-10's range.
The table below includes details on the ten shortest 787-10 routes scheduled for November. All of these routes originate at Singapore Changi Airport (SIN)
I Gusti Ngurah Rai International Airport (DPS)

These routes have impressive frequency, showing that Singapore Airlines uses its Dreamliners to move many people over short distances. The fifth-shortest route in November is the carrier's most frequent route that uses the Dreamliner, with 120 monthly frequencies from SIN to MNL. This route is 1,474 miles long and produces almost 60 million available seat miles. That is more than all but two of the routes.

Another exceptionally frequent route included is the third-shortest, taking passengers 876 miles (1,410 km) between SIN and BKK. The airline will complete this route 106 times in November, offering 35,722 seats. This produces over 31 million available seat miles. Meanwhile, it will run daily operations on the shortest route, traveling just 675 miles from SIN to SGN. The over 10,000 seats produce 6.8 million available seat miles.
The 787-10's Position Within The Singapore Airlines Fleet

The 787-10's position within the Singapore Airlines' fleet shows sound logic behind this usage. The carrier lacks narrowbody options that would traditionally operate these short services. Its only single-aisle aircraft are its 26 Boeing 737 MAX 8 jets. These planes have a total capacity of 154 seats split between economy class and business class. This is less than half the 337-passenger capacity of Singapore Airlines' 787-10s. This means the airline's 737 fleet has a total capacity of 4,004 passengers, compared with 9,436 for its Dreamliners. The 787-10 can simply take more of a chunk out of the high-capacity needs within a region packed with huge cities.
The table below shows Singapore Airlines' current fleet, using Planespotters.net data, revealing the position of the 787-10 within it

On the other hand, all the carrier's widebody aircraft are overengineered for short-haul routes. The most numerous widebody aircraft in its fleet is the A350-900. This jet has a massive range of 8,500 nautical miles (15,750 km), which can extend to 9,700 nautical miles (17,964 km). As a result, the A350-900 has proven effective on long-haul and premium-dense routes. +
How Singapore Airlines Configures Its Dreamliners

Singapore Airlines' Dreamliner configuration has been built with high-frequency and high-capacity needs in mind, making it ideal for moving many people between cities in the Southeast Asia region. Premium passengers have access to 36 business class seats in a 1-2-1 configuration, while the rest of the aircraft is taken up by a massive 301-seat economy cabin. Singapore Airlines has no premium economy class available on this jet. Just one row in this economy cabin is marked as extra legroom.
The table below shows the dimensions of the seats in each of the two cabins, making use of Seat Maps data
20 inches (51 cm) - expands when armrests are lowered

36 seats is admittedly a substantial business-class cabin, which seems to go against the high-capacity, short-haul philosophy this article has focused on. However, Singapore Airlines uses a staggered layout that squeezes in these seats in a relatively small area. Furthermore, although these seats are lie-flat, they have a shorter pitch and narrower width than what business-class passengers would usually expect.
Singapore Airlines Still Flies Some Long Routes With Its Dreamliners

Despite the prevalence of routes under 2,000 miles (3,200 km), there are still some routes that get closer to the typical way in which carriers use widebody aircraft. In November, Singapore Airlines will fly its 787-10s over 3,000 miles (4,830 km) on four routes. These will be Adelaide Airport (ADL), Tokyo Narita International Airport (NRT), Chubu Centrair International Airport (NGO) in Nagoya, and Osaka's Kansai International Airport (KIX).
body_zh: 路易斯是一位军事历史学家，也是领先的军事历史月刊《战争史》杂志的特约撰稿人。他还对私人和商业航空感兴趣。
波音公司将 787-10 梦想飞机打造为最大、航程最短的梦想飞机型号。这使得它非常适合高频次、高需求的中长航线。然而，其最大航程为 7,500 海里（13,890 公里），仍然能够执行传统的长途任务。新加坡航空将其 787-10 飞机转向不同的方向，用它们来飞行非常短的航线，通常是窄体喷气式飞机的领域。
出于多种原因，新加坡航空以意想不到的方式使用其梦想客机。 787-10 是一款现代化喷气式飞机，取代了该航空公司老式的宽体飞机。它具有高密度配置，非常适合运送大量乘客。它还具有燃油效率高且用途广泛的特点，使其在多种路线上都具有成本效益。答案也在于新加坡航空目前的机队，该机队缺乏与其他飞机一起执飞短途航线的能力。
新加坡航空使用 787-10 执飞一些短途​​航线
Cirium 数据显示，新加坡航空 787-10 将于 11 月份执飞 26 条航线。这涉及总共 1,129 次运营和超过 380,000 个座位，每架飞机上有 337 个座位。这 26 条航线中的大部分都是支线航线，航程不到 787-10 的三分之一。
下表包含 11 月安排的 10 条最短 787-10 航线的详细信息。所有这些航线均始发于新加坡樟宜机场 (SIN)
伍拉·赖国际机场 (DPS)
这些航线的频率令人印象深刻，这表明新加坡航空利用其梦想飞机在短距离内运送了许多人。 11 月份第五短的航线是该航空公司使用梦想飞机最频繁的航线，每月有 120 班从 SIN 飞往 MNL 的航班。这条航线全长 1,474 英里，提供近 6000 万可用座位英里。这比除两条路线之外的所有路线都多。
另一条异常频繁的航线是第三短的航线，乘客在新加坡和曼谷之间行驶 876 英里（1,410 公里）。该航空公司将在11月份完成该航线106趟航班，提供35,722个座位。这将产生超过 3100 万可用座位里程。同时，它将在最短的路线上进行日常运营，从 SIN 到 SGN 仅行驶 675 英里。超过 10,000 个座位可产生 680 万可用座位里程。
787-10 在新加坡航空机队中的地位

787-10 在新加坡航空机队中的位置表明了这种用法背后的合理逻辑。该航空公司缺乏传统上运营这些短途航班的窄体飞机选择。其唯一的单通道飞机是 26 架波音 737 MAX 8 喷气式飞机。这些飞机共有 154 个座位，分为经济舱和商务舱。这还不到新加坡航空 787-10 客机 337 名乘客容量的一半。这意味着该航空公司 737 机队的总载客量为 4,004 名乘客，而梦想飞机的载客量为 9,436 人。 787-10 可以轻松满足大城市密集地区的大容量需求。
下表使用 Planespotters.net 数据显示了新加坡航空当前的机队，揭示了 787-10 在其中的位置
另一方面，该航空公司的所有宽体飞机都针对短途航线进行了过度设计。其机队中数量最多的宽体飞机是 A350-900。这架喷气式飞机的航程可达 8,500 海里（15,750 公里），最长可达 9,700 海里（17,964 公里）。因此，A350-900 已被证明在长途和高端密集航线上非常有效。 +
新加坡航空如何配置其梦想飞机
新加坡航空的梦想客机配置在设计时就考虑到了高频次和大容量的需求，使其成为东南亚地区城市之间运送大量人员的理想选择。高级乘客可以使用 1-2-1 布局的 36 个商务舱座位，而飞机的其余部分则由拥有 301 个座位的大型经济舱占据。新加坡航空的这架飞机没有豪华经济舱。该经济舱中只有一排被标记为额外的腿部空间。
下表利用座位图数据显示了两个客舱的座位尺寸
20 英寸（51 厘米）- 扶手降低时膨胀
36个座位固然是一个相当大的商务舱，但这似乎违背了本文所关注的大容量、短途飞行的理念。然而，新加坡航空采用交错布局，将这些座位挤在相对较小的区域内。此外，虽然这些座椅是平躺式的，但它们的间距和宽度比商务舱乘客通常期望的更短。
新加坡航空仍使用其梦想飞机执飞一些长途航线
尽管 2,000 英里（3,200 公里）以下的航线很普遍，但仍有一些航线更接近航空公司使用宽体飞机的典型方式。 11 月，新加坡航空将在 4 条航线上使用 787-10 飞机，飞行里程超过 3,000 英里（4,830 公里）。这些机场包括阿德莱德机场 (ADL)、东京成田国际机场 (NRT)、名古屋中部国际机场 (NGO) 和大阪关西国际机场 (KIX)。

title_en: Air Algerie Business Class Airbus A330neo Review: Utterly Awful
title_zh: 阿尔及利亚航空商务舱空客 A330neo 评论：非常糟糕
summary: I flew Air Algerie's A330-900neo business class from Montreal to Algiers. The seats were fine, but indifferent crew, no menus, no alcohol and a three-hour meal made it miserable.
summary_zh: 我乘坐阿尔及利亚航空的 A330-900neo 商务舱从蒙特利尔飞往阿尔及尔。座位很好，但工作人员冷漠，没有菜单，没有酒，还有三杯酒。
body_en: For the first long haul segment of my Orient Express adventure via Africa trip , I flew Air Algerie’s Airbus A330-900neo business class on the 6hr50min flight from Montreal (YUL) to Algiers (ALG). I had heard almost entirely negative things about Air Algerie, which intrigued me, naturally! Well, now that I’ve flown Air Algerie I can confirm that everything I heard was true, and then some.

I don’t want to be dramatic — obviously flying business class is better than economy — but honestly, just about everything sucked. On the plus side, the seats as such were fine, but that’s where the good news ends. The food was not good, and took an insanely long amount of time to be served. There were no amenity kits… or menus… or meal choice… or alcohol… or diet soda. If the crew were any more indifferent, they would’ve been invisible.

I wouldn’t fly Air Algerie again unless I absolutely had to, which… I can’t imagine that’ll ever be the case. Honestly, Air Algerie made me yearn for my recent flight on Turkmenistan Airlines , which was at least fun.
How I booked my Air Algerie business class ticket
Air Algerie is a pretty isolated airline, which perhaps reflects Algeria overall — the country just isn’t interested in visitors, and getting a visa requires jumping through hoops.

So Air Algerie doesn’t have any useful partnerships when it comes to earning or redeeming miles. As a result, booking a cash ticket is just about the only option, unless you’re a frequent flyer with the airline. Air Algerie tends to have rather steep business class fares, despite its lackluster product.
However, I did manage to find a rather attractive one-way business class fare. I booked the following in business class for $1,171 in cash
10/03 AH2701 Montreal to Algiers departing 4:10PM arriving 5:00AM (+1 day)
10/04 AH4000 Algiers to Tunis departing 7:10AM arriving 8:30AM
The first segment was operated by an Airbus A330-900neo, while the second segment was operated by an Airbus A320 that was wet leased from Avion Express.
Air Algerie business class check-in, lounge, & boarding

I had flown into Montreal the same day from Miami (MIA) on Air Canada Rouge, so I had an extended layover. I was at the Air Algerie check-in counter before it opened at 12:30PM, and there was already quite the queue of passengers waiting. Unsurprisingly, and as is very common for North Africa flights, people had a ton of checked bags.

It took me around 30 minutes to get checked in, since there was one counter for business class, and there were half a dozen people in front of me. At first I was asked if I had a visa for Algeria, though I explained I was in transit, which seemed to catch the check-in agent off guard. Air Algerie is clearly targeted at the local community, and doesn’t see much international connecting traffic.

Security was a breeze, and Air Algerie sends its business class passengers to the National Bank Lounge, which is the contract lounge in the international portion of the terminal. I won’t do a full review, but it was actually a pretty pleasant facility, with plenty of seating, lots of natural light, and it wasn’t very crowded.

The food selection was pretty average, with a handful of hot options, plus cheese, cold cuts, etc. There was coffee, tea, wine, beer, and soft drinks. I made the mistake of saving my hunger and thirst for onboard the Air Algerie flight!

My Air Algerie flight was departing from gate A58, with boarding scheduled for 3:10PM, a full hour before departure. I was at the gate early enough to see the inbound aircraft arrive, and goodness, what a stunner it was!

The Montreal route is primarily served by an A330neo with the registration code 7T-VLB, which is in a special livery celebrating the country’s football team. Looking at the plane was honestly the best part of the flight experience, unfortunately.

The boarding area got very full before departure, with lots of passengers in wheelchairs, and lots of crowding around the gate. Boarding ended up starting at 3:20PM, with those needing extra time, as well as business class passengers, being invited to board first.
I can’t describe how excited I was to step onboard, as I always love trying new airlines! I wasn’t fully prepared for the level of indifference shown by every part of the experience, though.

body_zh: 在我乘坐东方快车非洲之旅的第一个长途航段中，我乘坐阿尔及利亚航空的空客 A330-900neo 商务舱，从蒙特利尔 (YUL) 飞往阿尔及尔 (ALG)，飞行时间 6 小时 50 分钟。我听到的关于阿尔及利亚航空的几乎都是负面消息，这自然引起了我的兴趣！好吧，既然我乘坐了阿尔及利亚航空的航班，我可以确认我听到的一切都是真的，而且还有一些。
我不想戏剧化——显然商务舱比经济舱好——但说实话，一切都很糟糕。从好的方面来说，座位本身还不错，但好消息也就到此为止了。食物不好吃，而且花了很长时间才上菜。没有洗漱用品包……或菜单……或膳食选择……或酒精……或无糖汽水。如果船员们再冷漠一点，他们就会被隐形了。
除非绝对必要，否则我不会再乘坐阿尔及利亚航空的航班，这……我无法想象这种情况会发生。老实说，阿尔及利亚航空让我向往最近乘坐土库曼斯坦航空的航班，这至少很有趣。
我如何预订阿尔及利亚航空商务舱机票
阿尔及利亚航空是一家相当孤立的航空公司，这或许反映了阿尔及利亚的整体情况——该国对游客不感兴趣，而且获得签证需要克服重重困难。
因此，阿尔及利亚航空在赚取或兑换里程方面没有任何有用的合作伙伴关系。因此，预订现金机票几乎是唯一的选择，除非您是该航空公司的常旅客。尽管阿尔及利亚航空的产品表现平平，但其商务舱票价往往相当昂贵。
不过，我确实找到了相当有吸引力的单程商务舱票价。我以 1,171 美元现金预订了以下商务舱机票
10/03 AH2701 蒙特利尔 飞往 阿尔及尔 出发时间 4:10PM 到达 5:00AM（+1 天）
10/04 AH4000 阿尔及尔 飞往 突尼斯 出发时间 7:10AM 到达 8:30AM
第一段由空客 A330-900neo 运营，第二段由从 Avion Express 湿租的空客 A320 运营。
阿尔及利亚航空商务舱办理登机手续、休息室和登机
我当天乘坐加航 Rouge 从迈阿密 (MIA) 飞往蒙特利尔，因此停留时间较长。中午12点30分，我在阿尔及利亚航空值机柜台开门前，已经有不少乘客在排队等候。毫不奇怪，就像北非航班上很常见的那样，人们有大量托运行李。
我花了大约30分钟才办理登机手续，因为有一个商务舱柜台，而且我前面有六六个人。一开始我被问到是否有阿尔及利亚的签证，尽管我解释说我是在过境，这似乎让办理登机手续的代理人措手不及。阿尔及利亚航空显然以当地社区为目标，国际转机航班不多。
安检轻而易举，阿尔及利亚航空将商务舱乘客送往国家银行休息室，这是航站楼国际部分的合同休息室。我不会做全面的评论，但它实际上是一个非常令人愉快的设施，有充足的座位，充足的自然光线，而且不是很拥挤。
食物选择很一般，有一些热食，还有奶酪、冷盘等。有咖啡、茶、葡萄酒、啤酒和软饮料。我犯了一个错误，就是把饥饿和口渴留在阿尔及利亚航空的航班上！
我乘坐的阿尔及利亚航空航班从 A58 登机口起飞，登机时间定于下午 3:10，即起飞前整整一个小时。我很早就到了登机口，看到入境飞机抵达，天哪，这真是太令人惊叹了！
蒙特利尔航线主要由注册代码为 7T-VLB 的 A330neo 提供服务，该飞机采用庆祝该国足球队的特殊涂装。不幸的是，看着飞机确实是飞行体验中最好的部分。
起飞前，登机区已经人满为患，有很多坐轮椅的乘客，登机口周围也挤满了人。登机最终于下午 3:20 开始，需要额外时间的乘客以及商务舱乘客将被邀请首先登机。
我无法形容登上飞机时的兴奋，因为我一直喜欢尝试新的航空公司！不过，我还没有完全准备好应对体验的各个部分所表现出的冷漠程度。
