title_en: The Airlines That Offer Amenity Kits To Economy Class Passengers In 2026
title_zh: 2026 年向经济舱乘客提供旅行套件的航空公司
summary: Amenity kits are becoming ever rarer in economy class.
summary_zh: 经济舱中的洗漱用品越来越少。
body_en: Journalist - Steven has a varied background in communications, and it was this passion for writing combined with his in-depth knowledge of the aviation industry that led him to Simple Flying. A keen linguist, he also has experience in translation and interpreting. Based in Palma, Spain

For decades, amenity kits were seen as a small but thoughtful touch that helped define the long-haul flying experience, with eye masks, socks, toothbrushes, and even branded pouches making their way into the hands of passengers across multiple cabins. While premium cabins have continued to refine and elevate their offerings, the story in economy class has been very different.

In 2026, complimentary amenity kits in economy are increasingly rare, largely confined to ultra-long-haul routes or a small group of full-service carriers seeking to differentiate their product. Rising costs, changing passenger expectations, and a stronger focus on unbundled fares have all contributed to the decline of the amenity kit in economy class. Many airlines now provide basic comfort items only on request .
Pick an aircraft to see how many are in the air right now
A380 747 787 A350 777 737 MAX A320neo More types

Meanwhile, others have removed them entirely in favor of buy-on-board options or sustainability-driven reductions in single-use products. However, a handful of carriers still see value in offering amenity kits at the back of the plane, using them as a subtle branding tool and a way to enhance the long-haul experience.

Etihad Airways is one of the few full-service carriers that still hands out amenity kits in economy class, but only on long-haul flights exceeding roughly six hours. Rather than a disposable bag of single-use plastics, Etihad Airways' economy class amenity kit comes in the form of a reusable tote bag containing typical essentials.

These include noise-canceling earplugs, an eye shade, and a small hand cream, all presented more as comfort tools than luxury gifts. The focus, true to the carrier’s evolving inflight product strategy, leans into practicality and sustainability rather than high-end cosmetics. This approach from the carrier, based at Abu Dhabi International Airport (AUH), reflects a broader trend across the industry.

Specifically, when airlines still offer economy kits, they are often pared back and designed to be useful beyond the flight itself, with recyclable or recycled materials and minimal environmental impact. Aside from the amenity kits, Etihad Airways’ economy class provides a practical and comfortable travel experience.

It has seats that feature adjustable headrests and recline, allowing passengers to rest or work during their flights. Each seat is equipped with a personal entertainment screen that offers a wide selection of movies, TV programs, music, and games, ensuring passengers have access to in-flight entertainment throughout their journey.

Qantas has also bucked the trend by continuing to offer economy class amenity kits on selected long-haul international routes. According to the oneworld carrier's own inflight experience pages, these kits typically include a dental set, an eye mask, and earplugs, packaged in a decorative felt pouch made from recycled PET bottles.

This provides a strong example of how carriers are trying to balance comfort with environmental responsibility. Unlike in premium cabins, where high-end branded items are now common, Qantas’ economy class amenity kits aim for simple comfort and sustainability. However, only select long-haul and ultra-long-haul flights see these amenity kits in economy class.

A prime example is the carrier's non-stop service between Perth Airport (PER) and London Heathrow Airport (LHR). These flights, operated by the Boeing 787-9 , can reach up to 17 hours in length. As such, any additional comforts like a complimentary amenity kit are sure to be appreciated by passengers.

On flights where the amenity kit is not offered as standard in economy class, Qantas offers a selection of additional travel essentials on request across its international network. Qantas is in the midst of one of its most ambitious fleet renewal programs in decades, transforming ultra-long-haul flying. A key part of this strategy is the introduction of next-generation Airbus aircraft.

These include the Airbus A350-1000ULR, which will be the key player in the carrier's non-stop Project Sunrise flights connecting Australia with Europe and the US. In total, the airline has committed to a massive order of over 200 new aircraft for the Qantas Group, with major types including the Airbus A220-300, Airbus A321XLR , Airbus A350-1000ULR, and Boeing 787 models among its future lineup.

The Airbus A220-300 is already in service with QantasLink, replacing older regional aircraft and offering passengers a lighter, quieter cabin with more space and modern amenities. Meanwhile, the A321XLR has started flying domestically and will soon operate longer-range international routes.

Emirates is well known around the world for its high level of luxury across all travel classes. The carrier, based at Dubai International Airport (DXB), still provides amenity kits in economy class, albeit primarily on long-haul services and often only on overnight flights.

Emirates' current range of amenity kits is particularly distinctive, designed in partnership with wildlife conservation groups and printed with hand-drawn artwork highlighting endangered species. These amenity kits typically include comfort basics like socks, an eye shade, earplugs, and a dental kit, all contained in a reusable pouch made from sustainable materials such as recycled polyester and paper.

Emirates' hard product is unrivaled, too. The carrier continues to reinforce its reputation as one of the world’s most dynamic long-haul airlines in 2026, blending fleet modernization with an industry-leading passenger experience.

The airline’s ambitious multi-billion-dollar retrofit program is now underway , with over 200 Airbus A380 and Boeing 777-300ER aircraft scheduled to receive refreshed cabins. These will feature next-generation seat designs across all classes, upgraded in-flight entertainment, and ultra-fast WiFi.
body_zh: 记者 - 史蒂文在传播领域拥有不同的背景，正是这种对写作的热情与他对航空业的深入了解相结合，促使他创立了《简单飞行》。作为一位敏锐的语言学家，他还拥有翻译和口译经验。总部位于西班牙帕尔马
几十年来，洗漱用品包被视为一种小而贴心的服务，有助于定义长途飞行体验，眼罩、袜子、牙刷，甚至品牌小袋都在多个客舱的乘客手中。虽然高级客舱不断完善和提升其服务，但经济舱的情况却截然不同。
到 2026 年，经济舱中免费提供的洗漱包将越来越少，主要局限于超长途航线或一小部分寻求差异化产品的全方位服务航空公司。成本上升、乘客期望变化以及对非捆绑票价的更加关注，都导致了经济舱洗漱包的减少。许多航空公司现在只根据要求提供基本的舒适物品。
选择一架飞机，看看现在有多少架飞机在空中
与此同时，其他人则完全取消了它们，转而支持船上购买选项或可持续发展驱动的一次性产品的减少。然而，少数航空公司仍然认为在飞机后部提供旅行套件很有价值，将其用作微妙的品牌工具和增强长途飞行体验的一种方式。
阿提哈德航空是少数仍在经济舱发放洗漱包的全方位服务航空公司之一，但仅限于飞行时间超过约六小时的长途航班。阿提哈德航空的经济舱洗漱包不是一次性塑料袋，而是可重复使用的手提袋，里面装有典型的必需品。
其中包括降噪耳塞、眼罩和小护手霜，所有这些都更像是舒适的工具，而不是奢华的礼物。其重点是实用性和可持续性，而不是高端化妆品，这符合该航空公司不断发展的机上产品战略。总部位于阿布扎比国际机场 (AUH) 的航空公司的这一做法反映了整个行业的更广泛趋势。
具体来说，当航空公司仍然提供经济套件时，它们通常会被削减，并被设计为在飞行本身之外有用，使用可回收或再生材料，并将对环境的影响降至最低。除了洗漱包外，阿提哈德航空的经济舱还提供实用、舒适的旅行体验。
它的座椅具有可调节头枕和倾斜角度，让乘客在飞行期间休息或工作。每个座位均配备个人娱乐屏幕，提供丰富的电影、电视节目、音乐和游戏选择，确保乘客在整个旅程中都能享受机上娱乐。
澳洲航空也逆势而上，继续在部分长途国际航线上提供经济舱旅行套装。根据 oneworld 航空公司自己的机上体验页面，这些套件通常包括一套牙具、一个眼罩和耳塞，包装在由回收 PET 瓶制成的装饰毛毡袋中。
这提供了一个强有力的例子，说明承运人如何努力平衡舒适性与环境责任。与高级客舱中常见的高端品牌物品不同，澳洲航空的经济舱洗漱包旨在实现简单的舒适性和可持续性。然而，只有部分长途和超长途航班的经济舱才会配备这些洗漱包。
一个典型的例子是该航空公司在珀斯机场 (PER) 和伦敦希思罗机场 (LHR) 之间提供的直达服务。这些航班由波音 787-9 运营，飞行时间最长可达 17 小时。因此，任何额外的舒适设施（例如免费的旅行套件）一定会受到乘客的赞赏。
对于经济舱不提供标准洗漱用品的航班，澳洲航空可通过其国际网络根据要求提供一系列额外的旅行必需品。澳洲航空正在进行数十年来最雄心勃勃的机队更新计划之一，以改变超长途飞行。该战略的一个关键部分是引进下一代空客飞机。
其中包括空中客车 A350-1000ULR，它将成为该航空公司连接澳大利亚与欧洲和美国的直达“日出计划”航班的主要参与者。澳航已承诺为澳洲航空集团订购超过 200 架新飞机，主要机型包括空客 A220-300、空客 A321XLR、空客 A350-1000ULR 和波音 787 等未来机型。
空客 A220-300 已在 QantasLink 投入使用，取代老式支线飞机，为乘客提供更轻、更安静的客舱，并提供更多空间和现代化设施。与此同时，A321XLR已开始执飞国内航线，并将很快运营远程国际航线。
阿联酋航空以其所有旅行级别的高水平奢华而闻名于世。这家总部位于迪拜国际机场 (DXB) 的航空公司仍然在经济舱提供洗漱包，不过主要是在长途航班上，而且通常只在夜间航班上提供。
阿联酋航空目前的旅行套装系列特别独特，是与野生动物保护组织合作设计的，并印有强调濒危物种的手绘艺术品。这些洗漱用品包通常包括袜子、眼罩、耳塞和牙具等舒适的基本用品，所有这些都装在由再生聚酯和纸张等可持续材料制成的可重复使用的小袋中。
阿联酋航空的硬产品也是无与伦比的。该航空公司将机队现代化与行业领先的乘客体验融为一体，继续巩固其作为 2026 年全球最具活力的长途航空公司之一的声誉。
该航空公司耗资数十亿美元的雄心勃勃的改造计划目前正在进行中，预计有 200 多架空客 A380 和波音 777-300ER 飞机将获得更新的客舱。这些飞机将采用适用于所有舱位的新一代座椅设计、升级的机上娱乐系统和超高速 WiFi。

title_en: How Many Crew Members Does It Take To Fly A C-17 Globemaster?
title_zh: 驾驶 C-17 环球霸王需要多少名机组人员？
summary: Almost 300 C-17 Globemasters have been built since production began in 1991.
summary_zh: 自 1991 年开始生产以来，已制造了近 300 架 C-17 Globemaster。
body_en: Journalist - Steven has a varied background in communications, and it was this passion for writing combined with his in-depth knowledge of the aviation industry that led him to Simple Flying. A keen linguist, he also has experience in translation and interpreting. Based in Palma, Spain

The C-17 Globemaster III is one of the most capable military transport aircraft in service, designed to move troops, heavy equipment, and humanitarian supplies across considerable distances. Despite its enormous size and ability to carry some of the military's heaviest vehicles, the aircraft requires surprisingly few people to operate, with a standard flight crew of just three members. The United States Air Force (USAF) identifies the C-17 crew as a pilot, a copilot, and a loadmaster. However, the number of personnel aboard can increase depending on the nature of the mission, particularly when the aircraft is being used for medical evacuations or other specialist operations. Understanding these crew members' responsibilities helps explain how such a large aircraft can operate with a relatively small team.
The C-17 Globemaster III Requires Just Three Crew Members

According to the USAF, the standard crew of a C-17 consists of three people: a pilot, a copilot, and a loadmaster. This is a relatively small crew considering the aircraft's dimensions, four powerful engines, and ability to transport substantial military cargo. This arrangement lets the aircraft complete demanding transport missions without requiring many personnel onboard. The two pilots operate the aircraft, manage its flight systems, and ensure it reaches its destination safely. Meanwhile, the loadmaster oversees the cargo compartment and ensures everything being transported is loaded, positioned, and secured correctly. Each position has a distinct purpose, although the three crew members must work closely together throughout the mission. The relatively small crew is also an important part of the C-17's operational design, as reducing manpower requirements helps limit personnel exposure to risk while also lowering long-term operating costs. This is particularly valuable for military transportation operations, which can involve frequent deployments, demanding schedules, and missions into challenging environments. Unlike commercial passenger aircraft, where cabin crew members are responsible for passenger services and safety procedures, the C-17 is primarily designed around military transportation requirements. Its standard crew therefore focuses on flying the aircraft and managing its cargo rather than providing conventional airline services. Additional personnel can still be carried when a particular operation requires specialist support.
What Do The Two C-17 Globemaster III Pilots Do?

The pilot and copilot share responsibility for flying the C-17, which measures 174 feet in length and has a wingspan of over 169 ft. Operating an aircraft of this size requires considerable training, especially because the C-17 is expected to perform missions that involve carrying exceptionally heavy loads and operating from airfields unsuitable for many larger transport aircraft. The pilots manage the aircraft's four turbofan engines, navigation equipment, flight controls, and other systems necessary for safe operation. They also coordinate flight planning, monitor weather conditions, communicate with air traffic control, and manage the aircraft during takeoff, cruise, and landing. Their responsibilities require careful coordination, especially when operating in unfamiliar locations or under demanding military conditions.

One of the C-17's most impressive characteristics is its ability to operate from a relatively short and narrow runway . The aircraft can use runways measuring just 3,500 feet long and 90 feet wide. This capability gives military planners greater flexibility when delivering supplies and personnel to airfields that may not be accessible to conventional heavy transport aircraft. The C-17, manufactured by McDonnell Douglas and Boeing , also has a distinctive ability to reverse under its own power, allowing it to back up and perform a three-point turn on narrow runways. This feature can be especially useful at remote airfields with limited maneuvering space. The pilots must understand these capabilities and their limitations to ensure that the aircraft can operate safely in demanding locations.
The Loadmaster Is Responsible For The Aircraft's Cargo

Although the two pilots handle the aircraft's flight operations, the third crew member, the loadmaster, has an equally important responsibility. This specialist manages the cargo compartment, ensuring that equipment, supplies, and personnel are loaded correctly and secured for the flight. The position is particularly important because the C-17 can transport a remarkably diverse range of military equipment. The C-17 features a large rear cargo ramp and door that allow vehicles and other heavy equipment to be driven or loaded directly into the aircraft. The loadmaster determines how cargo should be arranged, taking into account its weight, dimensions, and position within the aircraft. Correct weight distribution is essential because an improperly balanced load can affect the aircraft's handling and overall flight safety.

The C-17 can transport up to 170,900 lbs of cargo across 18 pallet positions. Its payload capacity also allows it to carry large military vehicles, including the M1 Abrams main battle tank, which weighs approximately 69 tons in certain configurations. Other potential cargo includes armored vehicles, military trucks, trailers, and equipment needed to support operations in the field. Before departure, the loadmaster checks that the cargo has been properly secured and that its distribution meets the aircraft's loading requirements. The responsibility does not end once the aircraft leaves the runway, as the loadmaster must also oversee cargo-related procedures during the flight and prepare for unloading at the destination. This makes the position essential to the C-17's transportation mission.
How The C-17 Carries Troops & Performs Airdrops

The C-17 is not limited to transporting vehicles and equipment, as it can also carry large numbers of military personnel. Depending on the configuration, the aircraft can carry up to 102 troops or paratroopers, making it an important part of military operations that require moving personnel quickly between bases or deploying them directly into operational areas. In airborne operations, the aircraft can release paratroopers through its rear cargo area. These missions require careful coordination between the pilots and loadmaster, as the aircraft must maintain the appropriate flight conditions while personnel prepare to exit. The loadmaster manages the airdrop process and helps ensure that the operation follows the required procedures.
body_zh: 记者 - 史蒂文在传播领域拥有不同的背景，正是这种对写作的热情与他对航空业的深入了解相结合，促使他创立了《简单飞行》。作为一位敏锐的语言学家，他还拥有翻译和口译经验。总部位于西班牙帕尔马

C-17 Globemaster III 是现役能力最强的军用运输机之一，旨在长距离运输部队、重型装备和人道主义物资。尽管其尺寸巨大并且能够运载一些军用最重的车辆，但该飞机的操作人员却出人意料地少，标准机组人员只有三名。美国空军 (USAF) 将 C-17 机组人员认定为飞行员、副驾驶和装卸长。然而，机上人员的数量可能会根据任务的性质而增加，特别是当飞机用于医疗后送或其他专业操作时。了解这些机组人员的职责有助于解释如此大型的飞机如何以相对较小的团队运行。
C-17 Globemaster III 只需三名机组人员

据美国空军称，C-17 的标准机组人员由三人组成：一名飞行员、一名副驾驶和一名装载主管。考虑到飞机的尺寸、四个强大的发动机以及运输大量军用货物的能力，这是一个相对较小的机组人员数量。这种安排使飞机能够完成要求苛刻的运输任务，而无需机上太多人员。两名飞行员操作飞机，管理其飞行系统，并确保飞机安全到达目的地。与此同时，装载主管负责监督货舱，并确保运输的所有物品均正确装载、定位和固定。尽管三名机组人员必须在整个任务过程中密切合作，但每个职位都有不同的目的。相对较少的机组人员也是 C-17 运营设计的重要组成部分，因为减少人力需求有助于限制人员面临的风险，同时还降低长期运营成本。这对于军事运输行动尤其有价值，因为军事运输行动可能涉及频繁的部署、严格的时间表以及在充满挑战的环境中执行任务。与商用客机由机组人员负责乘客服务和安全程序不同，C-17 主要是围绕军事运输要求而设计的。因此，其标准机组人员专注于驾驶飞机和管理货物，而不是提供传统的航空服务。当特定操作需要专家支持时，仍然可以携带额外的人员。
两名 C-17 环球霸王 III 飞行员做什么？

飞行员和副驾驶共同负责驾驶 C-17，C-17 长 174 英尺，翼展超过 169 英尺。操作这种尺寸的飞机需要大量的训练，特别是因为 C-17 预计要执行的任务涉及携带异常重的负载，并且在不适合许多大型运输机的机场运行。飞行员管理飞机的四个涡轮风扇发动机、导航设备、飞行控制和安全操作所需的其他系统。他们还协调飞行计划、监测天气状况、与空中交通管制部门沟通，并在起飞、巡航和着陆期间管理飞机。他们的职责需要仔细协调，特别是在陌生地点或苛刻的军事条件下行动时。

C-17 最令人印象深刻的特点之一是它能够在相对较短且狭窄的跑道上运行。该飞机可使用长度仅为 3,500 英尺、宽度仅为 90 英尺的跑道。这种能力使军事规划者在向传统重型运输机可能无法到达的机场运送物资和人员时具有更大的灵活性。由麦道公司和波音公司制造的 C-17 还具有独特的依靠自身动力反转的能力，使其能够在狭窄的跑道上倒车并进行三点转弯。此功能在机动空间有限的偏远机场特别有用。飞行员必须了解这些功能及其局限性，以确保飞机能够在要求苛刻的地点安全运行。
装卸员负责飞机的货物

虽然两名飞行员负责飞机的飞行操作，但第三名机组人员，即装载主管，承担着同样重要的责任。该专家负责管理货舱，确保设备、物资和人员正确装载并确保飞行安全。这一地位尤为重要，因为 C-17 可以运输种类繁多的军事装备。 C-17 具有大型后货坡道和门，允许车辆和其他重型设备直接驾驶或装载到飞机上。装载管理员根据货物的重量、尺寸和在飞机内的位置来确定货物的排列方式。正确的重量分配至关重要，因为不平衡的负载会影响飞机的操控和整体飞行安全。

C-17 可以在 18 个托盘位置运输最多 170,900 磅的货物。其有效载荷能力还使其能够运载大型军用车辆，包括 M1 艾布拉姆斯主战坦克，在某些配置下重约 69 吨。其他潜在的货物包括装甲车、军用卡车、拖车以及支持现场行动所需的设备。起飞前，装载管理员检查货物是否已正确固定，其分布是否满足飞机的装载要求。一旦飞机离开跑道，责任并没有结束，因为装卸员还必须在飞行过程中监督与货物相关的程序，并准备在目的地卸货。这使得该位置对于 C-17 的运输任务至关重要。
C-17 如何运载部队和执行空投
C-17不仅限于运输车辆和设备，还可以运载大量军事人员。根据配置的不同，该飞机最多可搭载 102 名士兵或伞兵，使其成为需要在基地之间快速转移人员或将人员直接部署到作战区域的军事行动的重要组成部分。在空降作战中，飞机可以通过其后货舱释放伞兵。这些任务需要飞行员和装载管理员之间的仔细协调，因为飞机必须在人员准备离开时保持适当的飞行条件。装载管理员管理空投过程并帮助确保操作遵循所需的程序。

title_en: Allegiant Air Cuts More Sun Country Flights From Minneapolis Despite “Really Strong” Demand
title_zh: 尽管需求“非常强劲”，忠诚航空还是削减了更多从明尼阿波利斯出发的太阳城航班
summary: Allegiant cuts more Sun Country flights at Minneapolis despite strong demand, as pilot shortages and Delta's growing presence threaten competition.
summary_zh: 尽管需求强劲，忠诚航空还是削减了明尼阿波利斯的更多太阳城航班，因为飞行员短缺和达美航空不断增加的业务威胁到了竞争。
body_en: Experienced ICAO English Language Proficiency Instructor for pilots and ATCOs and conference interpreter who is passionate about facilitating effective communication within aviation-related businesses. Possess a deep understanding of the aviation industry, including aviation regulations, terminology, and industry-specific communication protocols. Has been working at numerous airshows across Europe since 2014. Being an ultralight pilot in her free time, she also promotes safety and efficiency in aviation operations.

Allegiant Air is preparing to further reduce Sun Country Airlines ' passenger schedule at Minneapolis–Saint Paul International Airport (MSP), despite acknowledging that demand in the Twin Cities remains exceptionally strong. During its third-quarter 2026 earnings call on November 4, Allegiant CEO Greg Anderson confirmed that Sun Country's pilot staffing levels remain below requirements, limiting the airline's ability to operate its planned services. The latest comments raise further questions about how quickly the Minnesota-based carrier can rebuild its network after Allegiant acquired it in May.

The situation matters because Minneapolis is Sun Country's home market and one of the most important battlegrounds in its competition with Delta Air Lines . While Allegiant has repeatedly promised to restore and expand the airline's presence, Delta's substantial operations and growing recruitment efforts have created additional challenges. With fewer Sun Country flights available, Minneapolis travelers could also face reduced competition and potentially higher fares on popular leisure routes.
Pilot Shortages Force Further Schedule Cuts Despite Strong Demand

Allegiant's latest financial update indicates that Sun Country's operational difficulties are continuing into the final months of 2026. Anderson acknowledged that pilot attrition has improved since the previous earnings call, but staffing remains insufficient to support the airline's desired schedule. As a result, the company expects to continue operating below its intended passenger capacity as recruitment and training progress.

The reductions are noticeable at MSP, where Sun Country has historically provided an important low-cost alternative to Delta. Earlier cuts removed about 348 September departures, representing roughly one-third of the airline's previously scheduled flights that month. According to the Minnesota Star Tribune, October's schedule was subsequently reduced by around 20% year over year, while November's was approximately 8% lighter. The latest reporting on Sun Country's Minneapolis reductions illustrates how the changes are affecting passengers.

Despite the continued reductions, Anderson emphasized that the underlying market remains attractive, and the airline plans to expand there and to restore capacity as staffing improves, with recruitment classes already underway. During the November 4 earnings call, he said the following

"The demand in the Twin Cities is really strong. We want to add capacity there. So for our Sun Country flying, I would expect we'll start adding back flying as the staffing levels rebuild. We have Allegiant. Expect sometime in 2027 to be able to fly Allegiant aircraft from Allegiant bases into the Twin Cities and add some incremental flying. "
Delta's Minneapolis Dominance Makes Recovery More Difficult But Not Impossible

One of Sun Country's biggest challenges is competition for experienced pilots, particularly from Delta. After Allegiant's acquisition, many Sun Country pilots reportedly left for larger airlines, with many joining Delta. Allegiant previously acknowledged that pilot attrition was much higher than anticipated, creating an unexpected operational challenge during the integration process.

Delta's position makes the situation particularly difficult. Minneapolis is one of its most important hubs, and the airline consistently accounts for approximately 70% of the airport's passenger market. Its extensive domestic and international network, larger fleet, and recruitment capabilities give it considerable advantages over Sun Country. As reported in our coverage of Sun Country's pilot departures , pilots moving to Delta have become a major operational challenge for the airline.

The consequences extend beyond staffing. Sun Country has also expanded its cargo operations, particularly through its partnership with Amazon . Cargo flights have increasingly competed for available aircraft and crew resources, adding pressure on scheduled passenger services. Meanwhile, Delta can potentially benefit from reduced competition on routes where Sun Country previously offered lower fares. Although this does not mean Delta will automatically replace every discontinued service, its dominant position gives it considerable influence over the Minneapolis market.

However, Sun Country still has an important competitive advantage: its low-cost airline business model, affordable fares, and focus on leisure destinations could help it attract price-sensitive travelers who might otherwise choose Delta, allowing the Minnesota-based carrier to remain a meaningful competitor at its home airport.
Can Allegiant Rebuild Sun Country Before Delta Takes More Ground?

The situation also raises questions about Allegiant's original ambitions for the acquisition. When the deal was announced, the combined company presented Minneapolis as a major growth opportunity, promising additional destinations and improved passenger connectivity . However, the immediate aftermath has been considerably more complicated, with workforce departures and schedule reductions undermining those ambitions.

Allegiant nevertheless insists that the current situation is temporary. Anderson indicated that recruitment classes are full and that the company expects to begin restoring Sun Country's passenger capacity as more pilots become available. Furthermore, Allegiant expects to introduce its own aircraft into Minneapolis operations sometime in 2027, potentially adding incremental capacity from its existing bases. The company sees the Twin Cities as a long-term growth opportunity, not a market it intends to abandon.

Nevertheless, Delta's growing presence represents a considerable competitive threat. With Sun Country temporarily reducing its operations, Delta could strengthen its position on overlapping routes, potentially making it harder for the low-cost carrier to regain market share. Discussions among Minneapolis travelers on Reddit also highlight concerns about pilot recruitment, competition, and future ticket prices. Whether Allegiant can reverse the trend will depend on how quickly it rebuilds Sun Country's workforce and restores the capacity that made the airline an important competitor at MSP.
body_zh: 经验丰富的国际民航组织飞行员和空中交通管制员英语语言能力讲师以及会议口译员，热衷于促进航空相关业务中的有效沟通。对航空业有深入的了解，包括航空法规、术语和行业特定的通信协议。自 2014 年以来，她一直在欧洲各地的众多航展上工作。作为一名超轻型飞行员，她在业余时间还致力于提高航空运营的安全性和效率。

尽管忠诚航空承认双子城的需求仍然异常强劲，但仍准备进一步减少太阳乡村航空在明尼阿波利斯-圣保罗国际机场 (MSP) 的乘客班次。在 11 月 4 日举行的 2026 年第三季度财报电话会议上，Allegiant 首席执行官格雷格·安德森 (Greg Anderson) 确认，Sun Country 的飞行员人员配备水平仍低于要求，限制了该航空公司运营其计划服务的能力。最新的评论进一步引发了人们的疑问，即这家总部位于明尼苏达州的航空公司在 Allegiant 五月份收购后能够以多快的速度重建其网络。
这种情况很重要，因为明尼阿波利斯是太阳城的本土市场，也是与达美航空竞争的最重要战场之一。尽管忠实航空公司一再承诺恢复和扩大该航空公司的业务，但达美航空的大量运营和不断增加的招聘工作带来了额外的挑战。由于太阳城航班减少，明尼阿波利斯的旅客也可能面临竞争减少以及热门休闲航线票价可能上涨的情况。
尽管需求强劲，飞行员短缺仍迫使航班进一步削减
Allegiant 最新的财务更新表明，Sun Country 的运营困难将持续到 2026 年的最后几个月。安德森承认，自上次财报电话会议以来，飞行员的流失情况有所改善，但人员配备仍然不足以支持该航空公司预期的时间表。因此，随着招聘和培训的进展，该公司预计将继续在低于预期载客量的情况下运营。

MSP 的降价幅度非常明显，Sun Country 历来为达美航空提供了重要的低成本替代方案。早些时候的削减行动取消了约 348 个 9 月出发的航班，约占该航空公司此前当月预定航班的三分之一。据《明尼苏达明星论坛报》报道，10 月份的航班安排随后同比减少了约 20%，而 11 月份的航班安排则同比减少了约 8%。关于明尼阿波利斯 Sun Country 航班减少的最新报告说明了这些变化对乘客的影响。
尽管裁员不断，安德森强调，基础市场仍然具有吸引力，该航空公司计划在那里扩张，并随着人员配备的改善而恢复运力，招聘课程已经开始。在 11 月 4 日的财报电话会议上，他表示：
“双子城的需求确实很强劲。我们希望增加那里的运力。因此，对于我们的太阳国航班，我预计随着人员配备水平的重建，我们将开始增加回程航班。我们有忠诚航空。预计在 2027 年的某个时候，能够将忠诚航空的飞机从忠诚航空基地飞往双子城，并增加一些增量飞行。”
达美航空在明尼阿波利斯的主导地位使复苏变得更加困难，但并非不可能
太阳国面临的最大挑战之一是对经验丰富的飞行员的竞争，尤其是来自达美航空的飞行员。据报道，忠实航空收购后，许多 Sun Country 飞行员转投大型航空公司，其中许多人加入了达美航空。 Allegiant 此前承认，飞行员流失率远高于预期，在整合过程中造成了意想不到的运营挑战。
达美航空的立场让情况变得尤为困难。明尼阿波利斯是其最重要的枢纽之一，该航空公司一直占据该机场约 70% 的客运市场。其广泛的国内和国际网络、更大的机队和招募能力使其比太阳国具有相当大的优势。正如我们在《太阳之国》飞行员离港报道中所报道的那样，飞行员转至达美航空已成为该航空公司面临的主要运营挑战。
其后果超出了人员配置的范围。 Sun Country 还扩大了其货运业务，特别是通过与亚马逊的合作。货运航班对可用飞机和机组人员资源的竞争日益激烈，增加了定期客运服务的压力。与此同时，达美航空可能会受益于Sun Country先前提供较低票价的航线竞争减少。尽管这并不意味着达美航空将自动替换所有已停止的服务，但其主导地位使其对明尼阿波利斯市场具有相当大的影响力。
然而，太阳之国仍然拥有重要的竞争优势：其低成本航空业务模式、实惠的票价以及对休闲目的地的关注，有助于吸引对价格敏感的旅客，否则他们可能会选择达美航空，从而使这家总部位于明尼苏达州的航空公司在其本土机场仍然是一个有意义的竞争对手。
在达美航空取得更多进展之前，忠实航空能否重建太阳之国？
这种情况也引发了人们对 Allegiant 收购的最初野心的质疑。当交易宣布时，合并后的公司将明尼阿波利斯视为一个主要的增长机会，承诺提供更多目的地并改善乘客连通性。然而，直接后果要复杂得多，劳动力离职和日程减少破坏了这些雄心壮志。
尽管如此，Allegiant 坚称目前的情况只是暂时的。安德森表示，招聘班已满，随着更多飞行员的出现，该公司预计将开始恢复太阳国的客运能力。此外，Allegiant 预计将在 2027 年某个时候将自己的飞机引入明尼阿波利斯运营，这可能会增加其现有基地的增量运力。该公司将双城视为长期增长机会，而不是打算放弃的市场。

然而，达美航空不断增长的影响力构成了相当大的竞争威胁。随着太阳之国暂时减少运营，达美航空可能会加强其在重叠航线上的地位，这可能会使这家低成本航空公司更难重新获得市场份额。明尼阿波利斯旅客在 Reddit 上的讨论也凸显了对飞行员招募、竞争和未来票价的担忧。 Allegiant 能否扭转这一趋势将取决于它以多快的速度重建 Sun Country 的劳动力并恢复使该航空公司成为 MSP 重要竞争对手的能力。

title_en: Can You Redeem Hotel Points For Others? Yes, You Just Have To Know How
title_zh: 您可以为他人兑换酒店积分吗？是的，你只需要知道如何
summary: Most major hotel programs let you redeem points for friends and family, but the rules differ. Here's how Accor, Choice, Hilton, IHG, Marriott, Hyatt, and Wyndham handle it.
summary_zh: 大多数主要酒店计划都允许您为朋友和家人兑换积分，但规则有所不同。以下是 Accor、Choice、Hilton、IHG、Marriott、Hyatt、
body_en: One of the nice things about miles & points is being able to share the gift of travel with friends and family. Now, ideally we’d always be able to go along on those journeys, but there are some situations where that’s not practical, for obvious reasons.

Many people wonder if it’s possible to share their points with others, so they can enjoy a hotel stay. This is a great question, so I’d like to take a look at the policy of each individual program. While hotel loyalty programs in some ways offer more flexibility than airline loyalty programs, this isn’t necessarily one of those areas, as you sometimes have to jump through some hoops. For what it’s worth, in a separate post, I’ve addressed whether you can redeem airline miles for others .
Hotel policies on redeeming points for others

All major hotel loyalty programs have some sort of policy for allowing you to redeem your points for others. In some cases you can directly make a reservation for others, while in other cases you need to transfer your points to another member (at no cost).
Let’s break this down by program. Before we start, let me emphasize a couple of important points

This is only intended for situations where you want to redeem for friends and family, and not for selling points to others; selling rewards points violates the rules of virtually every travel loyalty program, and you could get in trouble if you’re caught doing this

Unless otherwise specifically noted below, you won’t receive points or elite credit when you book a stay for someone else, and that person also won’t receive any elite perks you may usually be entitled to; for more details, see my post on using your hotel elite perks for others

Accor Live Limitless (ALL) is the one hotel loyalty program that doesn’t let you redeem points for others. However, that’s not necessarily a huge loss. Keep in mind that Accor’s program is revenue based, and every 1,000 Accor points gets you €20 toward a hotel stay folio. You can use this for your own rooms or the rooms of those traveling with you, but you can’t just gift them to a third party.
Choice Privileges allows members to redeem points for reward nights for immediate family members, including a spouse, partner, children parents, in-laws, brothers, and sisters.

You can book a reward night for someone else in one of two ways. If you book through your online profile, be sure to include the name of the guest who will be staying in the room in the “Special Request” field. Alternatively, if booking by phone, ask the reservations agent to include the name of the guest in the notes field of the reservation.

Global Hotel Alliance’s GHA Discovery program is one that I’ve become increasingly intrigued by in recent times, given that it’s associated with dozens of independent hotel groups. GHA Discovery doesn’t have points, but instead, has D$, or Discovery Dollars, as they’re called. Each D$ gets you a dollar off an eligible hotel stay.

What’s cool is that you can actually transfer your D$ to others. A transfer can be initiated through the GHA Discovery app, and you just have to enter the recipient’s membership number and last name. You can begin sharing D$ if you’ve been a member of the program for at least 90 days, and you can perform or receive up to two transfers daily, with a minimum of D$100 and a maximum of D$500 per transaction.

The best way to book a Hilton Honors stay for someone else is to simply transfer points to their Hilton Honors account. Hilton has a free points sharing feature , whereby you can transfer points to another Hilton Honors member. You can transfer no more than 500,000 points to another member, and can receive no more than two million points per calendar year from others. That’s the easiest and most foolproof way to go about this.

One alternative is that you could call Hilton Honors to make a reservation, and explain you want to redeem your points for others. They might be able to book the reservation so that the second guest is listed on the reservation, and it’s documented that this is a gift. However, this might not be quite as seamless as just transferring your points to someone else.

One other option people use is that they’ll make a booking in their own name, and then in the “Add guest names” field on the payment page on Hilton’s website or app, they’ll add the name of the guest in the “Additional guests” field. I’ll talk more about this below — while this might work, it’s not really the official method you should use.

IHG One Rewards’ official policy is that you can book a reward night (either with points or free night awards) for someone else by making a booking via IHG’s website, and then adding an additional name to the reservation. In other words, you’re basically just making a reservation for yourself, with a second guest listed.
There’s also a comments section when making an IHG booking, so I’d recommend writing in that section about your intention to gift an award to someone else.
Marriott Bonvoy allows you to redeem your points directly for others, with some restrictions
You need to book your reservation by phone, by contacting Bonvoy customer support
You can book up to five gifted reservations per account per calendar year
body_zh: 里程和积分的好处之一是能够与朋友和家人分享旅行的礼物。现在，理想情况下我们总是能够继续这些旅程，但由于显而易见的原因，在某些情况下这是不切实际的。
许多人想知道是否可以与他人分享他们的积分，以便他们可以享受酒店住宿。这是一个很好的问题，所以我想看一下每个项目的政策。虽然酒店忠诚度计划在某些方面比航空公司忠诚度计划提供了更大的灵活性，但这不一定是这些领域之一，因为您有时必须跨越一些障碍。不管怎样，我在另一篇文章中讨论了是否可以为其他人兑换航空里程。
酒店为他人兑换积分的政策
所有主要的酒店忠诚度计划都有某种允许您将积分兑换给其他人的政策。在某些情况下，您可以直接为他人预订，而在其他情况下，您需要将积分转让给其他会员（免费）。
让我们按程序来分解一下。在开始之前，让我强调几个要点
这仅适用于您想为朋友和家人兑换积分的情况，而不是为了向他人出售积分；出售奖励积分几乎违反了所有旅游忠诚度计划的规则，如果被发现这样做，您可能会遇到麻烦
除非下文另有特别说明，否则当您为其他人预订住宿时，您不会获得积分或精英积分，并且该人也不会获得您通常有权享受的任何精英特权；有关更多详细信息，请参阅我关于为他人使用酒店精英福利的帖子
Accor Live Limitless (ALL) 是一项不允许您为他人兑换积分的酒店忠诚度计划。然而，这并不一定是巨大的损失。请记住，雅高计划以收入为基础，每 1,000 点雅高积分即可获得 20 欧元的酒店住宿费用。您可以将其用于您自己的房间或与您同行的人的房间，但您不能将它们作为礼物送给第三方。
选择特权允许会员用积分为直系亲属（包括配偶、伴侣、子女、父母、姻亲、兄弟和姐妹）兑换奖励住宿。
您可以通过以下两种方式之一为其他人预订奖励住宿。如果您通过在线个人资料预订，请务必在“特殊要求”字段中注明入住客房的客人姓名。或者，如果通过电话预订，请要求预订代理在预订的备注字段中注明客人的姓名。
全球酒店联盟的 GHA 探索计划是我最近越来越感兴趣的一项计划，因为它与数十家独立酒店集团有联系。 GHA Discovery 没有积分，但有 D$，即所谓的 Discovery Dollars。在符合条件的酒店住宿中，每消费 D 美元即可享受 1 美元优惠。
很酷的是，您实际上可以将您的 D$ 转移给其他人。可以通过 GHA Discovery 应用程序发起转账，您只需输入收件人的会员号和姓氏即可。如果您成为该计划的会员至少 90 天，则可以开始共享 D$，并且每天最多可以执行或接收两次转账，每笔交易最少 100 美元，最多 500 美元。
为他人预订希尔顿荣誉客会住宿的最佳方式是将积分转入他们的希尔顿荣誉客会账户。希尔顿拥有免费积分共享功能，您可以将积分转让给其他希尔顿荣誉客会会员。您向其他会员转让的积分不得超过 500,000 点，每个日历年从其他会员处接收的积分不得超过 200 万点。这是最简单、最万无一失的方法。
另一种选择是您可以致电希尔顿荣誉客会进行预订，并说明您想将积分兑换给其他人。他们也许可以进行预订，以便第二位客人被列在预订中，并且有记录表明这是一份礼物。然而，这可能不像将您的积分转移给其他人那么顺利。
人们使用的另一种选择是，他们将以自己的名义进行预订，然后在希尔顿网站或应用程序付款页面的“添加客人姓名”字段中，他们将在“其他客人”字段中添加客人的姓名。我将在下面详细讨论这一点 - 虽然这可能有效，但它实际上并不是您应该使用的官方方法。
IHG One Rewards 的官方政策是，您可以通过 IHG 网站预订，然后在预订中添加其他姓名，为其他人预订奖励住宿（无论是积分还是免费住宿奖励）。换句话说，您基本上只是为自己预订，并列出了第二位客人。
进行 IHG 预订时还有一个评论部分，因此我建议在该部分写下您向其他人赠送奖励的意图。
万豪旅享家允许您直接为他人兑换积分，但有一些限制
您需要通过电话联系 Bonvoy 客户支持进行预订
每个日历年每个账户最多可预订五次礼品预订

title_en: 5 Airports Built On Artificial Islands
title_zh: 5个建在人工岛上的机场
summary: Exploring the stories of five of the world's most unique airfields.
summary_zh: 探索世界上五个最独特机场的故事。
body_en: Luke Diaz is a freelance military writer with experience with active duty experience in the US Navy as well as defense and industrial engineering. He is a former Naval Flight Officer who performed tactical air control on the carrier-based E-2 Hawkeye.

Only a handful of airports in the world have been built on artificial islands, but each of those unique airfields has become a major global hub today. All were built to satisfy overwhelming demand for air travel where there was simply no other option but to reclaim land from the sea.

The incredible engineering behind each island aerodrome has not only allowed these unique airports to survive the test of time but to thrive. The very first airfield established on land reclaimed from the sea was opened in the mid-1990s in Japan. The history-making hub was soon followed by two more in China, and a fourth would later open in Japan, again.

The newest entry on this list is a unique airstrip that serves one of Turkey's busiest metropolitan areas in a land with virtually zero level ground. This forced an ambitious mega-project that raised an international gateway on the coast of the Black Sea.

Macau International Airport (MFM), opened in 1995, represents a masterclass in hyper-efficient marine engineering. Macau's genius lay in its surgical land reclamation strategy. While Hong Kong opted to place its entire airport infrastructure onto a singular massive artificial island , Macau's engineers targeted only what they absolutely needed to place in the water: the runway.

The passenger terminal and support facilities were constructed on Taipa Island. This structural split allowed the small space to secure a long runway without the immense capital requirement of a full offshore island. Only a narrow strip of reclaimed land wide enough to hold a single 11,024-foot (3,360-meter) runway and its immediate safety margins was reclaimed from the waters of the Pearl River Estuary.

While Macau's split-island concept saved billions of dollars upfront, its restricted footprint eventually became an operational bottleneck. With no room for aircraft parking and limited flexibility during peak traffic hours, the Macau International Airport Company officially launched a massive 129-hectare (319-acre) expansion.

The construction phase is scheduled to span from 2026 through 2028. When full reclamation wraps up in 2030, the airport's total usable layout will swell to 325 hectares. This targeted expansion will drastically increase the annual capacity from ten million to 13 million passengers.

Kansai International Airport (KIX), designed by renowned architect Renzo Piano and opened in 1994, stands as one of the most ambitious engineering projects of the 20th century. It was constructed entirely on a reclaimed artificial island within Osaka Bay to mitigate urban crowding at the city's legacy airport. The fundamental engineering challenge of KIX stems from the seabed geology of Osaka Bay.

The immense structural weight of the facility continually compresses the soft seabed clay, forcing water out and lowering the surface level. Engineers drove nearly one million sand columns into the seabed to act as vertical escape routes for the trapped water, forcing the clay to collapse and solidify more quickly. While operators anticipated this settlement, a significant volume of the subsidence occurred unexpectedly before commercial operations commenced.

When people hear that the island has dropped roughly 45 feet (13.66 meters) in total, they picture the airport actively plunging into the ocean. In reality, the vast majority of that drop happened during the initial construction phase. Since opening day, the airport structures themselves have dropped about 13 feet (3.84 meters).

The dramatic sinking has slowed to a virtual crawl, with the island settling a mere two inches (five cm) over the course of 2024. On September 4, 2018, Typhoon Jebi inundated the primary runway and terminal building, while unmoored vessel impacts severed the singular mainland transit bridge.

A fuel tanker unmoored by 110-mph winds crashed into the bridge connecting KIX to the mainland. This severed the airport's only road and rail link, trapping 8,000 passengers and staff on the artificial island. It required three weeks for all passenger flights to resume, challenging local officials' expectations and leaving the long-term efficacy of heightened seawalls against ongoing settling unresolved.

Ordu-Giresun Airport (OGU) was the third artificial island airport ever built, mirroring the ambition of Kansai but adapted for the unique topography of northern Turkey. It was constructed in the sea because Turkey’s Black Sea coast offered no flat ground among the dramatic Pontic Mountains. Engineers deposited approximately 35 million tons of rock into the water.

To secure a stable footprint, trucks made roughly 950,000 trips to deposit between 30 and 36 million tons of heavy stone into the ocean bed. The island features a single, fully capable asphalt runway measuring 9,842 feet (3,000 meters long and 45 meters wide. Since the island is built primarily of heavily compacted rock fill directly resting on a firmer coastal shelf, the operator reports zero structural settlement issues.

Additionally, as the Black Sea is notorious for its volatile swells, a colossal 7,435-meter (4.6-mile) protective breakwater wraps around the perimeter. The table above shows the key statistics of each island aerodrome, per data from Road Genius and official airport statistics.

In its true maiden year of 2015, the airport welcomed a modest 221,000 passengers . By 2016, that figure exploded by over 250% to roughly 777,000 annual passengers. To date, the coastal airfield has not been shuttered by the effects of a severe ocean storm. Today, the facility has grown to process well over 1.1 million passengers annually.

Chubu Centrair International Airport is commonly classified as Japan’s second major offshore airport after Kansai International. Opened in 2005 on an artificial island in Ise Bay, it serves as the primary international gateway to Japan's industrial heartland in and around the Nagoya area.

The island was sculpted into a unique curved D-shape with rounded corners rather than a sharp rectangle to allow prevailing bay currents to glide around the island. In the interest of harmonizing construction with wildlife, the plan even incorporated a dedicated wildlife sanctuary inside the island's footprint to protect nesting sites for the vulnerable Little Tern.

Instead of harsh, vertical concrete barricades that alienate marine life, engineers layered the sloped shoreline banks with natural stones. These rocks actively simulate natural rocky shores, encouraging the growth of seaweed beds and providing a thriving habitat and breeding ground for local fish and crabs.
body_zh: 卢克·迪亚兹 (Luke Diaz) 是一位自由军事作家，拥有在美国海军以及国防和工业工程领域服役的现役经验。他是一名前海军飞行军官，曾在舰载 E-2 鹰眼上执行战术空中控制。
世界上只有少数机场建在人工岛上，但这些独特的机场如今已成为全球主要枢纽。所有这些都是为了满足航空旅行的巨大需求而建造的，除了填海造地之外别无选择。
每个岛屿机场背后令人难以置信的工程不仅使这些独特的机场能够经受住时间的考验，而且蓬勃发展。第一个建在填海土地上的机场于 20 世纪 90 年代中期在日本启用。继这个创造历史的中心之后，中国又开设了两个中心，第四个中心随后又在日本开业。
此列表中的最新条目是一个独特的机场，为土耳其最繁忙的大都市区之一提供服务，该地区的地面几乎为零。这迫使我们实施一项雄心勃勃的大型项目，在黑海沿岸修建一个国际门户。
澳门国际机场 (MFM) 于 1995 年启用，堪称超高效海洋工程领域的大师级作品。澳门的天才在于其外科手术式的填海战略。虽然香港选择将其整个机场基础设施放置在一个巨大的人工岛上，但澳门的工程师只专注于他们绝对需要放置在水中的东西：跑道。
客运大楼及配套设施建于凼仔岛。这种结构上的分割使得狭小的空间能够确保一条长跑道，而无需建造一个完整的离岸岛屿所需的巨大资本。只有一条狭长的填海土地宽度足以容纳一条 11,024 英尺（3,360 米）长的跑道及其直接安全边际，是从珠江口水域填海而成的。
虽然澳门的分岛概念预先节省了数十亿美元，但其有限的占地面积最终成为运营瓶颈。由于没有足够的飞机停泊空间以及交通高峰时段的灵活性有限，澳门国际机场公司正式启动了占地 129 公顷（319 英亩）的大规模扩建工程。
建设阶段计划从 2026 年到 2028 年。当 2030 年全面填海工程完成时，机场的总可用布局将扩大到 325 公顷。此次有针对性的扩建将使年客运量从 1000 万人次大幅增加至 1300 万人次。
关西国际机场 (KIX) 由著名建筑师伦佐·皮亚诺 (Renzo Piano) 设计，于 1994 年投入使用，是 20 世纪最雄心勃勃的工程项目之一。它完全建在大阪湾内的一个填海人工岛上，以缓解该市旧机场的城市拥挤状况。关西国际机场的基本工程挑战源于大阪湾的海底地质。
该设施巨大的结构重量不断压缩柔软的海底粘土，将水排出并降低表面水平。工程师们将近一百万根沙柱打入海底，作为被困水的垂直逃生路线，迫使粘土更快地塌陷和凝固。尽管运营商预计会出现这种解决方案，但在商业运营开始之前却意外发生了大量沉降。
当人们听说该岛总共下降了约 45 英尺（13.66 米）时，他们会想象机场正沉入大海。事实上，绝大多数下降发生在最初的施工阶段。自开放之日起，机场结构本身已下降约 13 英尺（3.84 米）。
剧烈的下沉速度已放缓至近乎爬行的速度，在 2024 年期间，该岛仅下沉了两英寸（五厘米）。2018 年 9 月 4 日，台风飞燕淹没了主跑道和航站楼，而未停泊的船只撞击则切断了这座单一的大陆过境桥。
一艘因时速 110 英里的大风而脱锚的油轮撞上了连接关西国际机场和大陆的桥梁。这切断了机场唯一的公路和铁路连接，导致 8,000 名乘客和工作人员被困在人工岛上。所有客运航班需要三周时间才能恢复，这挑战了当地官员的期望，并使加高的海堤防止持续沉降的长期有效性悬而未决。
奥尔杜-吉雷松机场 (OGU) 是有史以来建造的第三座人工岛机场，反映了关西的雄心壮志，但又适应了土耳其北部独特的地形。它之所以建在海上，是因为土耳其的黑海海岸在雄伟的庞蒂克山脉之间没有平坦的地面。工程师将大约 3500 万吨岩石放入水中。
为了确保稳定的足迹，卡车行驶了大约 95 万次，将 30 至 3600 万吨重石沉积到海底。该岛有一条功能齐全的单一沥青跑道，长 9,842 英尺（长 3,000 米，宽 45 米）。由于该岛主要由直接位于更坚固的沿海陆架上的重压实岩石填充物建造，因此运营商报告零结构沉降问题。
此外，黑海因其汹涌的海浪而臭名昭著，7,435 米（4.6 英里）长的巨大防护防波堤环绕其周边。上表显示了每个岛屿机场的主要统计数据，数据来自 Road Genius 和官方机场统计数据。
2015 年，该机场迎来了真正的首年，接待了 221,000 名乘客。到 2016 年，这一数字激增了 250% 以上，达到每年约 777,000 人次。迄今为止，沿海机场尚未因严重海洋风暴的影响而关闭。如今，该设施已发展到每年接待超过 110 万名旅客。
中部国际机场通常被认为是继关西国际机场之后的日本第二大离岸机场。它于 2005 年在伊势湾的一座人工岛上开业，是通往名古屋地区及其周边日本工业中心地带的主要国际门户。
该岛被雕刻成独特的弧形 D 形，带有圆角，而不是尖锐的矩形，以便盛行的湾流在岛屿周围滑行。为了使建筑与野生动物协调一致，该计划甚至在岛上设立了一个专门的野生动物保护区，以保护脆弱的小燕鸥的筑巢地。
工程师们没有采用会疏远海洋生物的粗糙、垂直的混凝土路障，而是用天然石材在倾斜的海岸线上分层。这些岩石积极模拟天然岩石海岸，促进海藻床的生长，并为当地鱼类和螃蟹提供繁荣的栖息地和繁殖地。

title_en: Which Airlines Fly To The Most Destinations? Some May Surprise You
title_zh: 哪些航空公司飞往最多的目的地？有些可能会让你感到惊讶
summary: Turkish Airlines flies to the most countries, but not the most destinations. United tops that list, followed by American and Delta, with Turkish fourth and Ryanair fifth.
summary_zh: 土耳其航空 飞往的国家/地区最多，但目的地不是最多。联合航空位居榜首，其次是美国航空和达美航空，最后是土耳其航空
body_en: Recently, I wrote a post about the airlines that fly to the most countries . Turkish Airlines wins that title by a long shot, and has a 30+ country lead over the second most “global” airline.

In this post, I want to address a different but related topic — which airlines serve the most destinations? As you’d expect, this is a very different list. That’s because serving a lot of countries is much easier if you’re an airline that has a lot of service in Europe and Africa, given the number of countries there that are in close proximity. It’s one of the reason that US airlines don’t score that well when it comes to absolute number of countries served, despite otherwise being among the biggest carriers in the world.
However, the list of total number of destinations served is a different story…
The “big three” US carriers serve the most destinations
I don’t think anyone will be surprised by the three airlines that serve the most destinations. As it currently stands
United serves 398 destinations, including 230 domestic destinations and 168 international destinations
American serves 373 destinations, including 234 domestic destinations and 139 international destinations
Delta serves 317 destinations, including 214 domestic destinations and 103 international destinations

This makes sense. In terms of fleets, the “big three” US carriers are among the biggest in the world. A majority of their networks are domestic, which is why the airlines don’t rank that high when it comes to total number of countries served, but they do great when it comes to the total number of destinations served. Note that the number of destinations also includes flights operated by their regional subsidiaries.

I don’t think the order above will surprise anyone. United is of course the most global US airline, and has a very impressive route network, including with ultra long haul flights. Meanwhile American is a massive domestic airline, and has a strong network in Latin America and the Caribbean, which is why it doesn’t appear that far behind United in terms of international destinations. And Delta, ummm, gets a revenue premium.

Just in the interest of being thorough, I’m sure some people are curious how many destinations Southwest serves, since it’s an absolutely massive airline in the United States, though doesn’t operate long haul flights. That number is less impressive — it’s a total of 120 destinations, including 104 domestic destinations and 16 international destinations. That’s because the airline is more about depth of service than breadth of service, and doesn’t have a regional subsidiary.
Which other airlines serve the most destinations?

After US carriers, which airlines otherwise top the list of most destinations served? Most people wouldn’t be surprised to learn that Turkish takes that spot, serving 269 destinations, including 46 domestic destinations and 223 international destinations.
What about after that? Here are the next eight airlines (I think this is where some of the airlines may surprise people)
China Southern serves 223 destinations, including 143 domestic destinations and 80 international destinations
China Eastern serves 220 destinations, including 137 domestic destinations and 83 international destinations
Ryanair serves 217 destinations, including five domestic destinations and 212 international destinations
Air China serves 216 destinations, including 137 domestic destinations and 79 international destinations
British Airways serves 214 destinations, including 11 domestic destinations and 203 international destinations
Air Canada serves 208 destinations, including 48 domestic destinations and 160 international destinations
body_zh: 最近，我写了一篇关于飞往最多国家/地区的航空公司的文章。土耳其航空以遥遥领先的优势赢得了这一称号，并且比第二大“全球化”航空公司领先 30 多个国家/地区。
在这篇文章中，我想讨论一个不同但相关的主题——哪些航空公司提供的目的地最多？正如您所料，这是一个非常不同的列表。这是因为，如果您是一家在欧洲和非洲提供大量服务的航空公司，考虑到这些国家之间的距离很近，那么为许多国家/地区提供服务会容易得多。这是美国航空公司在服务国家的绝对数量方面得分不高的原因之一，尽管美国航空公司是世界上最大的航空公司之一。
然而，所服务的目的地总数列表却是另一回事……
美国“三大”航空公司提供最多目的地的服务
我认为任何人都会对服务最多目的地的三家航空公司感到惊讶。就目前情况而言
美联航飞往 398 个目的地，其中包括 230 个国内目的地和 168 个国际目的地
美国航空 飞往 373 个目的地，其中 234 个国内目的地和 139 个国际目的地
达美航空飞往 317 个目的地，其中 214 个国内目的地和 103 个国际目的地
这是有道理的。就机队而言，美国“三大”航空公司位居世界前列。他们的大部分网络都是国内网络，这就是为什么航空公司在服务的国家总数方面排名不那么高，但在服务的目的地总数方面却表现出色。请注意，目的地数量还包括其地区子公司运营的航班。
我认为上面的顺序不会让任何人感到惊讶。美联航当然是最全球化的美国航空公司，拥有非常令人印象深刻的航线网络，包括超长途航班。与此同时，美国航空是一家大型国内航空公司，在拉丁美洲和加勒比海地区拥有强大的网络，这就是为什么它在国际目的地方面并没有落后于联合航空太多。达美航空，嗯，获得了收入溢价。
为了彻底了解，我相信有些人很好奇西南航空有多少个目的地，因为它在美国是一家绝对大型的航空公司，尽管不运营长途航班。这个数字并不那么令人印象深刻——总共有 120 个目的地，其中包括 104 个国内目的地和 16 个国际目的地。这是因为该航空公司更注重服务深度而不是服务广度，并且没有地区子公司。
还有哪些航空公司提供飞往最多目的地的航班？
除了美国航空公司之外，还有哪些航空公司位居服务目的地最多的航空公司之列？如果土耳其航空占据这一位置，大多数人不会感到惊讶，该航班飞往 269 个目的地，其中包括 46 个国内目的地和 223 个国际目的地。
那之后呢？以下是接下来的八家航空公司（我认为这是一些航空公司可能会让人们感到惊讶的地方）
南航飞往 223 个目的地，其中国内目的地 143 个，国际目的地 80 个
东航通航 220 个目的地，其中国内 137 个，国际 83 个
瑞安航空 飞往 217 个目的地，其中包括 5 个国内目的地和 212 个国际目的地
国航 通航城市 216 个，其中国内 137 个，国际 79 个
英国航空 飞往 214 个目的地，其中 11 个国内目的地和 203 个国际目的地
加拿大航空 飞往 208 个目的地，其中包括 48 个国内目的地和 160 个国际目的地

title_en: How To Combine World Of Hyatt Points Between Accounts For Free
title_zh: 如何免费合并账户之间的凯悦天地积分
summary: World of Hyatt now lets members transfer points to others for free, up to 525,000 per year, all online. Here's how the process works and why it's worth doing.
summary_zh: 凯悦天地现在允许会员免费向其他人转让积分，每年最多可转让 525,000 点积分，全部在线转让。以下是该过程的工作原理以及其为何如此
body_en: The major hotel loyalty programs all have different policies when it comes to combining points between accounts belonging to different members. I’ve already covered the options and policies for Hilton Honors and Marriott Bonvoy , and in this post, I’d like to take a look at the policy of World of Hyatt.

The good news is that World of Hyatt recently introduced a new way to transfer points to others for free, and I’d argue the program now has among the most generous policies in the industry. Long story short, you can transfer or receive up to 525,000 points per year, and this can all be done online, and at no cost. In this post, I’d like to look more closely at the mechanics of Hyatt points transfers.
World of Hyatt offers a generous feature to allow members to transfer points to others at no cost. Let’s first cover the basic rules for Hyatt points transfers
World of Hyatt members can transfer points to other members at a 1:1 ratio at no cost
World of Hyatt members can transfer a minimum of 1,000 points, in increments of 500 points above that
World of Hyatt members can transfer up to 525,000 points per transaction, and may transfer or receive up to that many points across accounts per calendar year
World of Hyatt members must have opened their account at least 60 days ago in order to send or receive points
World of Hyatt members are limited to making one free points transfer per calendar month, and six free points transfers per calendar year
World of Hyatt points are generally transferred within 24 hours (often nearly instantly), though some transfers may require additional review, and could take up to 10 business days

While bartering World of Hyatt points isn’t allowed, beyond that there’s no limit on who you can transfer points to, meaning that this isn’t strictly for family members, for people at the same household, etc.

It’s worth noting that this system is much better than it used to be. Back in the day combining Hyatt points required completing a form and took days, and you could only combine points in order to have sufficient points for a specific redemption. That policy no longer applies.
How to transfer World of Hyatt points to others

The process of transferring World of Hyatt points between members online is straightforward. To start, you can either follow this link , or go to your account overview page, and go to the section that reads “Gift your points more seamlessly.”
On the next page, you’ll want to go to the “Gift points or eligible awards” section, and then click “Gift your points.”
There you’ll first want to select how many points you want to transfer, using the slider.
Then on the next page, you’ll need to enter the account information for the account you want to move points to.

Then you’ll just need to confirm the details, and that’s it! Regarding transfer times, reports suggest transfers take anywhere from a few minutes to several days. It does seem like the more points you transfer, the more likely that it takes days for the transfer to go through. So if you are moving a large chunk of points, don’t be surprised if it takes some time.
The benefits of combining World of Hyatt points

What are the benefits to being able to combine points between World of Hyatt accounts? On the most basic level, it allows you to combine points so you have enough for an award stay . In other words, if you have two accounts with 15,000 points each, you can combine the points so you have enough for a one night stay at a hotel costing 30,000 points.

Furthermore, if you’re traveling as multiple people and one person has elite status, there’s value to booking the stay out of their account, so that you could take advantage of World of Hyatt Globalist or World of Hyatt Explorist benefits , for example.
body_zh: 在合并属于不同会员的帐户之间的积分时，主要的酒店忠诚度计划都有不同的政策。我已经介绍了希尔顿荣誉客会和万豪旅享家的选项和政策，在这篇文章中，我想了解一下凯悦天地的政策。
好消息是，凯悦天地最近推出了一种免费向他人转让积分的新方式，我认为该计划现在拥有业内最慷慨的政策之一。长话短说，您每年最多可以转让或接收 525,000 点积分，而且这一切都可以在线完成，而且无需支付任何费用。在这篇文章中，我想更仔细地了解凯悦积分转移的机制。
凯悦天地提供了一项慷慨的功能，允许会员免费将积分转让给其他人。我们首先介绍一下凯悦积分转移的基本规则

凯悦天地积分通常会在 24 小时内（通常几乎立即）转移，但某些转移可能需要额外审核，最多可能需要 10 个工作日
虽然凯悦天地积分不允许以物易物，但除此之外，您可以将积分转让给谁没有限制，这意味着这并不严格适用于家庭成员、同一家庭的人等。
值得注意的是，这个系统比以前要好得多。过去，合并凯悦积分需要填写表格并花费数天时间，而且您只能合并积分以获得足够的积分来进行特定兑换。该政策不再适用。
如何将凯悦天地积分转让给他人
在会员之间在线转移凯悦天地积分的过程非常简单。首先，您可以点击此链接，或转到您的帐户概述页面，然后转到“更无缝地赠送您的积分”部分。
在下一页上，您需要转到“赠送积分或符合条件的奖励”部分，然后单击“赠送您的积分”。
在那里，您首先要使用滑块选择要转移的点数。
然后在下一页上，您需要输入要将积分转移到的帐户的帐户信息。
然后您只需要确认详细信息即可！关于转移时间，报告显示转移需要几分钟到几天的时间。看起来您转移的积分越多，转移完成的时间就越有可能是几天。因此，如果您要移动大量点，并且需要一些时间，请不要感到惊讶。
合并World of Hyatt积分的好处
合并凯悦天地账户之间的积分有哪些好处？在最基本的层面上，它允许您合并积分，这样您就有足够的积分来享受奖励住宿。换句话说，如果您有两个账户，每个账户都有 15,000 积分，您可以将这些积分合并起来，这样您就有足够的积分在 30,000 积分的酒店住宿一晚。
此外，如果您与多人一起旅行，并且其中一人拥有精英身份，那么从他们的账户中预订住宿就很有价值，这样您就可以享受凯悦环球主义者天地或凯悦探索者天地礼遇。

title_en: Can You Redeem Airline Miles For Others? Yes, With Some Caveats
title_zh: 您可以为他人兑换航空里程吗？是的，但有一些注意事项
summary: Most airline loyalty programs let you redeem miles for anyone, but some Asian programs limit who you can book for. Here's how it works and which programs have restrictions.
summary_zh: 大多数航空公司的忠诚计划允许您为任何人兑换里程，但一些亚洲计划限制您可以为谁预订。这是它的工作原理和程序
body_en: While I love redeeming miles & points for an amazing first or business class flight, one thing that brings me even more joy is being able to do that for friends & family. Along those lines, in this post I’d like to talk about which airline loyalty programs allow you to redeem your points for others. In a separate post, I addressed the topic of whether you can redeem hotel points for others .
You can freely redeem airline miles for others

While there are some areas where airline loyalty programs are stingy, the ability to redeem miles for others isn’t among those. Generally speaking, airline loyalty programs will let you redeem your miles for anyone you’d like (I’ll note some exceptions below, but unless otherwise noted, that’s what you should expect).
You can almost always do this directly through your frequent flyer program account, by just entering the name of the traveler during the booking process.

Now, it’s important to emphasize that this is for situations where you truly want to gift your rewards to others. Bartering airline miles violates the policies of virtually any airline loyalty program , and your account could be suspended and ticket could be forfeited if you’re caught doing this (and airline auditing departments are quite savvy).
So if you are going to redeem your airline miles for others, make sure you do so in good faith, without expecting anything in return.
The logistics of redeeming airline miles for others
To make things as easy as possible, I’d recommend that the person redeeming miles be the one to make the booking, rather than the person being redeemed for. Admittedly the policies do vary by airline
Some airlines only let the account holder be the one to authorize a transaction
Some airlines let anyone make a reservation with miles, as long as they can verify specific account details
Some airlines have a PIN system, whereby you can redeem as long as you have the PIN for the account

If you’re making your reservation online, you can always just share your account number and password with someone to make a booking, though that does potentially pose a risk if you can’t fully trust the person (in which case you probably also shouldn’t share miles with them, come and think of it).

I won’t break that down by airline, since there are so many different policies, they sometimes change, and phone agents also often interpret them differently. However, the best way to go about this is to have the person with the miles make the booking. Just make sure you have the full, correct passport or travel document details for the traveler, so that the name matches the ID that will be presented at the time of travel.
The programs that don’t let you redeem miles for others

There are hundreds of airline loyalty programs out there, and a vast majority of them will allow you to redeem your miles for anyone you’d like. There are some exceptions, though, as some airlines either limit the number of people you can redeem your miles for, or limit the types of people you can redeem your miles for (for example, direct family members).

Most of the programs restricting who you can redeem for are based in Asia. Let me note some of the most common programs with restrictions below. I’d like to emphasize, though, that this list is by no means exhaustive, so if I’ve missed any major programs, please do let me know.

Let me also mention that this is all about the program you book through, rather than the airline you travel with. For example, while All Nippon Airways Mileage Club has restrictions, you could book an award on All Nippon Airways through a partner program without being subjected to these rules.

There are airlines with just a few airplanes that have loyalty programs, so I’ll be focusing on “major” airlines, which I’ll define as airlines with 50+ planes. With that in mind, below are some of the major programs with restrictions
All Nippon Airways Mileage Club only lets you redeem miles for relatives within two degrees of kinship
Asiana Club only lets you redeem miles for immediate family members
body_zh: 虽然我喜欢用里程和积分兑换令人惊叹的头等舱或商务舱航班，但给我带来更多快乐的一件事是能够为朋友和家人做到这一点。沿着这些思路，在这篇文章中，我想谈谈哪些航空公司的忠诚度计划允许您为其他人兑换积分。我在另一篇文章中讨论了是否可以为他人兑换酒店积分的主题。
您可以自由为他人兑换航空里程
虽然在某些领域航空公司的忠诚度计划很吝啬，但为他人兑换里程的能力却不在其中。一般来说，航空公司忠诚度计划将允许您将里程兑换给您想要的任何人（我将在下面指出一些例外情况，但除非另有说明，否则这就是您应该期望的）。
您几乎总是可以直接通过常旅客计划帐户执行此操作，只需在预订过程中输入旅行者的姓名即可。
现在，需要强调的是，这适用于您真正想将奖励送给他人的情况。交换航空里程几乎违反了所有航空公司忠诚度计划的政策，如果被发现这样做，您的帐户可能会被暂停，机票可能会被没收（航空公司审计部门非常精明）。
因此，如果您打算为他人兑换航空里程，请确保您真诚地这样做，而不期望任何回报。
为他人兑换航空里程的物流
为了让事情尽可能简单，我建议兑换里程的人是进行预订的人，而不是被兑换的人。诚然，政策确实因航空公司而异
一些航空公司只允许账户持有人授权交易
一些航空公司允许任何人使用里程进行预订，只要他们可以验证特定的帐户详细信息
一些航空公司有 PIN 系统，只要您有账户的 PIN 码就可以兑换
如果您在网上进行预订，您始终可以与某人共享您的帐号和密码来进行预订，尽管如果您不能完全信任该人，这确实可能会带来风险（在这种情况下，您可能也不应该与他们共享里程，想一想）。
我不会按航空公司来细分，因为有很多不同的政策，它们有时会发生变化，而且电话代理也经常对它们进行不同的解释。然而，最好的方法是让拥有里程的人进行预订。只需确保您拥有旅行者完整、正确的护照或旅行证件详细信息，以便姓名与旅行时出示的身份证件相符。
不允许您为他人兑换里程的计划
市面上有数百个航空公司忠诚度计划，其中绝大多数都允许您将里程兑换给您想要的任何人。但也有一些例外，因为一些航空公司要么限制您可以兑换里程的人数，要么限制您可以兑换里程的人员类型（例如，直系家庭成员）。
大多数限制兑换对象的计划都位于亚洲。让我在下面列出一些最常见的有限制的程序。不过，我想强调的是，这个列表并不详尽，所以如果我错过了任何主要项目，请告诉我。

title_en: Israel’s Israir eyes rival Arkia acquisition
title_zh: 以色列 Israir 有意收购 Arkia
summary: Israir is considering acquiring Israeli rival Arkia, a move that could create a larger airline group with five… The post Israel’s Israir eyes rival Arkia acquisition appeared first on AeroTime .
summary_zh: 以色列航空正在考虑收购以色列竞争对手 Arkia，此举可能会创建一个拥有 5 家航空公司的更大的航空集团……
body_en: Israir is considering acquiring Israeli rival Arkia, a move that could create a larger airline group with five widebody and 15 narrowbody aircraft under the Israeli flag. The proposed fleet structure was outlined by Israir CEO Uri Sirkis in a letter to employees, where Sirkis addressed the potential acquisition and its benefits for the company’s future growth.

The deal could strengthen Israir position against international competitors, expand its operational capacity and reduce costs. However, the acquisition remains at a preliminary stage, with no agreement reached between the parties.

The proposal follows an approach from Arkia controlling shareholders, the Nakash family. On November 4, Israir confirmed that it had been contacted about a possible purchase. An initial meeting involving Israir chairman Moti Hazan, CEO Sirkis and Arkia shareholder representative Avi Hormaro subsequently took place. Israir has not yet begun financial due diligence.

In a letter to employees on November 6, 2026, Sirkis described the acquisition assessment as preliminary and stressed that there was no certainty it would result in a transaction. He also highlighted Israir investments in aircraft, infrastructure and technology as factors supporting its ability to consider the deal.

Arkia is seeking a buyer amid financial difficulties, having reportedly recorded losses of approximately $30 million during the first nine months of 2026. The potential sale is further complicated by disagreements between the owners and employees, who hold around 20% of the airline. Workers demonstrated against the shareholders’ actions on November 3, raising concerns about their ownership rights and employment conditions.

Any acquisition would require approval from Israel Competition Authority, as combining the country’s second- and third-largest airlines could significantly affect competition in the local aviation market.
For now, Israir has not announced an acquisition agreement or a timetable for completing the process.

title_en: Confused Air France Pilots Make Wrong Turn After Takeoff From LAX, Leading To Close Call
title_zh: 困惑的法航飞行员从洛杉矶国际机场起飞后转错方向，导致千钧一发
summary: An Air France A350 bound for Tahiti turned left after takeoff from LAX runway 24L, into the path of an American A321. The pilots then struggled to explain why.
summary_zh: 一架飞往塔希提岛的法航 A350 从洛杉矶国际机场 24L 跑道起飞后左转，进入美国 A321 的航线。飞行员随后奋力探索
body_en: An Air France Airbus A350 departing from Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) made a wrong turn after takeoff, sending the plane dangerously close to the path of an American Airlines Airbus A321. The way the pilots responded to this isn’t exactly great, though one thing is for sure — there seems to be a recurring problem involving runway 24L departures from the airport, whatever the cause may be.

YouTube channel You can see ATC has the audio and a visualization of an incident that happened shortly after 12AM on Saturday, November 7, 2026. It involves Air France flight AF28, which was operating to Papeete, French Polynesia (PPT).

LAX has four parallel runways, and the Air France A350 was cleared for takeoff on runway 24L, on the north side of the field. The Air France pilots were instructed to initially fly to the DLREY fix, instructions which they correctly read back.

Once through the DLREY fix, they were instructed to climb via their assigned SID (that they had received with clearance), but then the pilots suddenly made a turn to the left. The issue is that an American A321 had been cleared for takeoff on runway 25R just moments earlier, and that’s to the south of runway 24L.

So when the Air France pilots started turning to the left, they went directly into the path of the American plane. Fortunately the air traffic controller quickly caught this, but it created a traffic alert, and the planes had less than a mile of separation.

Mistakes happen, but what’s strange here is how this was handled after the initial incident. The air traffic controller asked the Air France pilots why they made a turn. The Air France pilot responded “standby,” which is fair enough. Pilots are supposed to be focused first on aviating, then on navigating, and then on communicating.

Moments later, the air traffic controller followed up and asked what departure the pilots had been instructed to fly. Once again, the pilot responded “standby one.” I do think the air traffic controller should’ve been a bit more patient here when a pilot is asking him to hold on for a second. At the same, the Air France pilots seemingly just kept stalling, and seemed to be unable to answer the question.

Of course we don’t know what was going on in the cockpit (it’s possible they were dealing with something else), but the controller wasn’t asking a complicated question. The pilots ended up getting a phone number for a possible pilot deviation.

It’s truly a mystery what caused the pilots to make that left turn, especially since they were flying to Tahiti, which is basically a straight westbound departure (and in the middle of the night, it’s not like you typically need to vector to the east when departing LAX).
LAX runway 24L departures are a consistent issue

Regardless of how good a system looks on paper, you of course have to consider human factors, and how systems are actually perceived. For reasons that are somewhat of a mystery, there seem to be repeated issues with planes departing from runway 24L at LAX making a turn to the left, and turning into the path of planes departing from runway 25R.

Just a couple of weeks ago, I covered how a TAP Air Portugal Airbus A330neo departing runway 24L at LAX made an unauthorized left turn immediately after takeoff, putting itself in the path of another jet.
Heck, just a couple of months ago, an Air France Boeing 777 departing runway 24L at LAX made an almost identical mistake, and turned left right after takeoff, when it wasn’t supposed to.

That’s only the tip of the iceberg in terms of the number of these incidents we’ve seen. I’m not sure what exactly is going on here, and if it’s a case of pilots programming their computers for a departure from runway 25R, only to get assigned runway 24L, or what.

But either way, it seems something should be done here. As redundant as it might sound when you’re sending pilots to a specific fix (which already tells them which direction they should go), it almost seems like air traffic control needs to add in a warning about not making a left turn without authorization. I mean, it sounds silly, but…

An Air France Airbus A350 departing LAX made an unauthorized left turn after takeoff, sending it right into the path of a departing American Airbus A321. The pilots really seemed to struggle with answering air traffic control’s basic questions, though I don’t know what was actually going on in the cockpit.

What’s so strange is how there seem to be repeated issues with departures from runway 24L, as we’ve now seen this “unauthorized left turn” situation from this exact runway several times in recent weeks alone.
What do you make of this LAX runway 24L issue?
body_zh: 一架从洛杉矶国际机场 (LAX) 起飞的法航空客 A350 飞机起飞后错误转弯，导致飞机危险地靠近美国航空空客 A321 的航线。飞行员对此的反应并不完全好，但有一点是肯定的——无论原因是什么，似乎总是出现一个涉及 24L 跑道从机场起飞的问题。
YouTube 频道 您可以看到 ATC 拥有 2026 年 11 月 7 日星期六凌晨 12 点后不久发生的一起事件的音频和可视化内容。该事件涉及法航 AF28 航班，该航班飞往法属波利尼西亚帕皮提 (PPT)。
洛杉矶国际机场有 4 条平行跑道，法航 A350 获准在机场北侧的 24L 跑道起飞。法航飞行员最初接到指示飞往 DLREY 定位点，他们正确地读回了指示。
一旦完成 DLREY 修复，他们被指示通过指定的 SID（他们已获得许可）爬升，但随后飞行员突然向左转弯。问题在于，一架美国 A321 不久前刚刚获准在 25R 跑道起飞，该跑道位于 24L 跑道以南。
因此，当法航飞行员开始向左转弯时，他们直接进入了美国飞机的航线。幸运的是，空中交通管制员很快发现了这一情况，并发出了交通警报，两架飞机的间隔不到一英里。
错误时有发生，但奇怪的是最初事件发生后如何处理。空中交通管制员询问法航飞行员为何转弯。法航飞行员的回答是“待命”，这很公平。飞行员应该首先专注于飞行，然后是导航，然后是沟通。
过了一会儿，空中交通管制员跟进并询问飞行员被指示从哪个航班起飞。飞行员再次回应“待命”。我确实认为，当飞行员要求空中交通管制员稍等时，他应该更有耐心。与此同时，法航飞行员似乎一直停滞不前，似乎无法回答这个问题。
当然，我们不知道驾驶舱里发生了什么（他们可能正在处理其他事情），但管制员并没有问一个复杂的问题。飞行员最终得到了可能发生偏差的电话号码。
导致飞行员左转的原因确实是一个谜，特别是因为他们飞往塔希提岛，这基本上是直接向西出发（在半夜，离开洛杉矶国际机场时通常不需要向东飞行）。
洛杉矶国际机场 24L 跑道起飞是一个持续存在的问题
无论系统在纸面上看起来有多好，您当然都必须考虑人为因素以及系统的实际感知方式。由于有些神秘的原因，从洛杉矶国际机场 24L 跑道起飞的飞机向左转，然后转入从 25R 跑道起飞的飞机的航线，似乎反复出现问题。
就在几周前，我报道了一架 TAP 葡萄牙航空的空客 A330neo 在洛杉矶国际机场 24L 跑道起飞后如何在起飞后立即未经授权左转，导致另一架飞机挡在了航线上。
哎呀，就在几个月前，一架法航波音 777 在洛杉矶国际机场 24L 跑道起飞时犯了几乎同样的错误，起飞后就向右左转，而这是不应该的。
就我们所看到的此类事件的数量而言，这只是冰山一角。我不确定这里到底发生了什么，是否是飞行员对计算机进行编程以从 25R 跑道起飞，却被分配到 24L 跑道，或者什么。
但无论如何，这里似乎应该做点什么。当您将飞行员发送到特定位置（已经告诉他们应该朝哪个方向行驶）时，这听起来可能是多余的，但空中交通管制似乎需要添加关于未经授权不得左转的警告。我的意思是，这听起来很愚蠢，但是……
一架从洛杉矶国际机场起飞的法航空客 A350 飞机在起飞后未经授权左转，直接进入了即将起飞的美国空客 A321 的航线。尽管我不知道驾驶舱内到底发生了什么，但飞行员似乎确实很难回答空中交通管制的基本问题。
奇怪的是，从 24L 跑道起飞的问题似乎屡屡出现，因为仅在最近几周，我们就多次看到从这条跑道出发的“未经授权左转”情况。
